title: Measles made a stealthy return as another virus took the spotlight.
abstract: Measles is reemerging, with cases and outbreaks increasing across the United States and other countries where measles had previously been eliminated. physicians have no experience with treating measles. However, the increasing likelihood of encountering not only children but also adults with measles requires a clinical review of the epidemiology, prevention, diagnosis, and management of this previously uncommon infection for general internal medicine physicians and hospitalists who care for adults in settings with measles reemergence. Prompt clinical suspicion, infection control measures, and notification of public health departments support timely diagnosis and disease control.

title: Timing of antiretroviral treatment initiation and seropositivity to measles virus among children living with HIV in rural Zambia.
abstract: Background Combination antiretroviral therapy (cART) reduces morbidity among children living with HIV (CHIV) but does not restore vaccine-induced measles immunity. Many CHIV now initiate cART before measles vaccination but the impact on measles seroprevalence is not understood. This study compared measles seropositivty between CHIV initiating cART before and after 9 months in Zambia. Methods This retrospective study was nested within a cohort study of CHIV and community-based studies in Macha, Zambia conducted from 2007-2020. Samples were tested for measles IgG antibodies by enzyme immunoassay from CHIV initiating cART at ages 0-8, 9-23, and 24-59 months and age-matched community-based controls. A cross-sectional analysis compared measles seroprevalence between CHIV groups after 6-12 months of cART and controls. A longitudinal analysis evaluated antibody concentrations from age 9 months through 48 months of cART and during the 2010-11 measles outbreak. Results In the cross-sectional analysis, measles seropositivity did not statistically differ after 6-12 months of cART by age at initiation (0-8: 30.8% [n=12/39]; 9-23: 37.0% [n=51/138]; 24-59 months: 26.6% [n=33/124]). Within CHIV groups, seropositivity was significantly lower than age-matched controls (63.5%, 75.7%, and 80.3%). Among 242 CHIV followed longitudinally, 46-56% had an antibody response, with estimated seroreversion in only 1.8-3.2 years. Among CHIV in 2010-11, 50% seroconverted or boosted with estimated seroreversion in 2.1 years. Conclusions Measles seroprevalence was low among CHIV, even when starting cART before 9 months of age, and the time to seroreversion was short. These findings support recommendations that CHIV, including infants, would benefit from periodic revaccination after immune reconstitution.

A cross-sectional analysis compared measles seroprevalence between CHIV groups after 6-12 months of cART and controls. A longitudinal analysis evaluated antibody concentrations from age 9 months through 48 months of cART and during the 2010-11 measles outbreak. Within CHIV groups, seropositivity was significantly lower than age-matched controls (63.5%, 75.7%, and 80.3%). Among 242 CHIV followed longitudinally, 46-56% had an antibody response, with estimated seroreversion in only 1.8-3.2 years. Among CHIV in 2010-11, 50% seroconverted or boosted with estimated seroreversion in 2.1 years. analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the impact of antiretroviral treatment (ART) initiation timing on measles seroprevalence among children living with HIV (CHIV) in rural Zambia. The research aimed to address the gap in understanding how early ART affects measles immunity, as cART reduces HIV-related morbidity but does not restore vaccine-induced immunity. A cross-sectional analysis compared seropositivity between CHIV who started ART before and after 9 months of age, alongside age-matched community controls. The results showed no significant difference in seropositivity by age at ART initiation, but seropositivity was lower in CHIV compared to controls. A longitudinal analysis revealed that antibody responses were common, with seroreversion occurring within 1.8-3.2 years. The authors concluded that measles seroprevalence remains low among CHIV, even when ART is initiated early, and that seroreversion occurs relatively quickly. These findings suggest that periodic revaccination may be necessary for CHIV to maintain measles immunity. The study's evidence is moderate in strength due to the absence of detailed limitations.

abstract_zh: 背景 联合抗逆转录病毒治疗 (cART) 降低了 HIV 感染儿童 (CHIV) 的发病率,但不能恢复 疫苗 诱导的 麻疹 免疫力。许多 CHIV 现在在 麻疹 麻疹 麻疹 血清流行率 之前启动 cART,但对 麻疹 血清流行率 的影响尚不清楚。本研究比较了赞比亚 CHIV 启动 cART 9 个月前后的 麻疹 血清阳性率。方法 这项回顾性研究嵌套在 队列研究 CHIV 研究和 2007 年至 2020 年在赞比亚马查进行的基于社区的研究中。通过酶免疫分析对 0-8、9-23 和 24-59 个月龄开始 cART 的 CHIV 样本以及基于社区的年龄匹配对照样本进行 麻疹 IgG 抗体测试。横断面分析比较了经过 6-12 个月的 cART 和对照组后 CHIV 组之间的 麻疹 血清流行率。纵向分析评估了从 9 个月大到 48 个月 cART 期间以及 2010-11 麻疹 暴发 期间的抗体浓度。结果 在横断面分析中,cART 6-12 个月后,麻疹 血清阳性率按开始年龄划分没有统计学差异(0-8 个月:30.8% [n=12/39];9-23 个月:37.0% [n=51/138];24-59 个月:26.6% [n=33/124])。在 CHIV 组中,血清阳性率显着低于年龄匹配的对照组(63.5%、75.7% 和 80.3%)。在 242 名 CHIV 患者中进行纵向随访,其中 46-56% 出现抗体反应,估计血清逆转仅需 1.8-3.2 年。2010-11 年 CHIV 感染者中,50% 出现血清转化或增强,估计在 2.1 年内出现血清转化。结论 麻疹 在 CHIV 中的 麻疹 水平较低,即使在 9 个月龄前开始 cART 时也是如此,而且血清逆转的时间很短。这些发现支持这样的建议:CHIV(包括婴儿)将受益于免疫重建后定期重新接种疫苗。

title: Population level immunity to measles and rubella 5 years before and after the MR campaign in urban Vellore, South India.
abstract: India aims to eliminate measles and rubella (MR) by 2026. Despite >90% vaccination coverage reported in NFHS-5 and NFHS-6, assessing population-level immunity gaps remains essential to guide strategies for protecting vulnerable groups. We leveraged biobanked samples from two community-based serosurveys conducted in urban Vellore in 2013 and 2022, representing periods 5 years before and after the nationwide MR vaccination campaign. Age- and sex-stratified participants were tested for measles- and rubella-specific IgG antibodies using ELISA. Seroprevalence estimates were compared across surveys, and generalized additive models (GAM) were used to assess age-specific seropositivity patterns. Effective reproduction numbers (Re) for measles and rubella were estimated using mixture modeling approaches. A total of 1,029 samples from 2013 and 718 samples from 2022 were analyzed. Measles seroprevalence increased from 33%, 41%, 47%, and 48% in the 1-5, 6-15, 16-40, and >40 years age groups in 2013 to 77%, 71%, 89%, and 96% respectively in 2022. Rubella seroprevalence increased from 32%, 67%, 76%, and 73% to 93%, 84%, 93%, and 98% across the same age groups. No significant sex-based differences were observed for either infection. The estimated Re declined from 7.4 to 3.6 for measles and from 1.8 to 0.8 for rubella following the MR campaign period. Population immunity improved by 2022, particularly for rubella. However, lower measles seroprevalence among children aged 1-15 years indicates persistent immunity gaps despite high vaccine coverage, highlighting the need for continued surveillance and targeted strategies to achieve measles-rubella elimination in India.

Despite >90% vaccination coverage reported in NFHS-5 and NFHS-6, assessing population-level immunity gaps remains essential to guide strategies for protecting vulnerable groups. We leveraged biobanked samples from two community-based serosurveys conducted in urban Vellore in 2013 and 2022, representing periods 5 years before and after the nationwide MR vaccination campaign. Age- and sex-stratified participants were tested for measles- and rubella-specific IgG antibodies using ELISA. Seroprevalence estimates were compared across surveys, and generalized additive models (GAM) were used to assess age-specific seropositivity patterns. Effective reproduction numbers (Re) for measles and rubella were estimated using mixture modeling approaches. A total of 1,029 samples from 2013 and 718 samples from 2022 were analyzed. Measles seroprevalence increased from 33%, 41%, 47%, and 48% in the 1-5, 6-15, 16-40, and >40 years age groups in 2013 to 77%, 71%, 89%, and 96% respectively in 2022. Rubella seroprevalence increased from 32%, 67%, 76%, and 73% to 93%, 84%, 93%, and 98% across the same age groups. No significant sex-based differences were observed for either infection. The estimated Re declined from 7.4 to 3.6 for measles and from 1.8 to 0.8 for rubella following the MR campaign period. Population immunity improved by 2022, particularly for rubella. However, lower measles seroprevalence among children aged 1-15 years indicates persistent immunity gaps despite high vaccine coverage, highlighting the need for continued surveillance and targeted strategies to achieve measles-rubella elimination in India.

title: Measles Screening at Registration Using an Electronic Medical Record-Based System.
abstract: A pediatric healthcare system located near a 2025 measles regional outbreak shares processes for developing electronic medical records-based measles screening at registration to promptly identify patients at high risk of measles and prevent secondary exposures. Buy-in was gained from stakeholders concerned about slowed registration and limited numbers of airborne isolation rooms by reporting registration times and fine-tuning screening to reduce screening positivity iteratively to rates as low as 0.12 per 1000 encounters.

title: Canada’s loss of measles elimination after 27 years: a mathematical modelling analysis of the five major provincial outbreak waves in 2025–2026
abstract: Abstract Background Canada’s loss of measles elimination status in 2025 highlighted the vulnerability of populations with concentrated immunity gaps. Provincial incidence alone cannot readily distinguish relatively intense transmission within a small susceptible population from transmission involving a larger population. We quantified these differences across five provincial measles waves in 2025-2026. Methods We fitted a common susceptible–exposed–infectious–recovered (SEIR) model to weekly reported measles incidence for Ontario in 2025 and Alberta and Manitoba in 2025 and 2026. Mean latent and infectious periods were fixed at 10 and 8 days. We estimated the effective reproduction number ( R eff , 0 ), effective susceptible population ( S eff , 0 ), and profiled the initial infected number to evaluate province and wave-specific primary case model estimates. We calculate the initial exponential growth rate, doubling time, and peak full width at half maximum (FWHM) to characterize early epidemic growth and the duration of elevated incidence around each wave’s peak. Findings In 2025, Ontario’s effective reproduction number, R eff , 0 , was 1.9, with a model-estimated effective susceptible population, S eff , 0 , of 3,101 individuals, an initial doubling time of 2.4 weeks, and a peak FWHM of 12.3 weeks. Alberta had a similar R eff , 0 of 1.9, with S eff , 0 of 2,601 individuals, a doubling time of 2.4 weeks, and FWHM of 12.1 weeks. Manitoba had a lower R eff , 0 of 1.5 and S eff , 0 of 490 individuals, with a longer doubling time of 4.0 weeks and FWHM of 20.5 weeks. In 2026, Alberta’s R eff , 0 increased to 2.1 while S eff , 0 decreased to 383 individuals; doubling time shortened to 2.1 weeks and FWHM to 9.7 weeks. Manitoba’s R eff , 0 increased to 1.8 and S eff , 0 to 1,038 individuals, while doubling time shortened to 2.6 weeks and FWHM to 13.0 weeks. Interpretation Alberta’s smaller second wave combined the highest effective reproduction number with the shortest doubling time and peak duration, demonstrating that limited outbreak size can coexist with rapid transmission. Joint estimates of transmission intensity, epidemic pace, peak duration, and effective susceptible population provide complementary measures for comparing outbreaks and informing public-health planning. Together, these estimates provide a quantitative basis for distinguishing transmission intensity from the scale of susceptible involvement, supporting comparisons across outbreaks and informing the timing and scale of public-health responses for future outbreaks.

We quantified these differences across five provincial measles waves in 2025-2026. Methods We fitted a common susceptible–exposed–infectious–recovered (SEIR) model to weekly reported measles incidence for Ontario in 2025 and Alberta and Manitoba in 2025 and 2026. Mean latent and infectious periods were fixed at 10 and 8 days. We estimated the effective reproduction number ( R eff , 0 ), effective susceptible population ( S eff , 0 ), and profiled the initial infected number to evaluate province and wave-specific primary case model estimates. We calculate the initial exponential growth rate, doubling time, and peak full width at half maximum (FWHM) to characterize early epidemic growth and the duration of elevated incidence around each wave’s peak. Findings In 2025, Ontario’s effective reproduction number, R eff , 0 , was 1.9, with a model-estimated effective susceptible population, S eff , 0 , of 3,101 individuals, an initial doubling time of 2.4 weeks, and a peak FWHM of 12.3 weeks. Alberta had a similar R eff , 0 of 1.9, with S eff , 0 of 2,601 individuals, a doubling time of 2.4 weeks, and FWHM of 12.1 weeks. Manitoba had a lower R eff , 0 of 1.5 and S eff , 0 of 490 individuals, with a longer doubling time of 4.0 weeks and FWHM of 20.5 weeks. In 2026, Alberta’s R eff , 0 increased to 2.1 while S eff , 0 decreased to 383 individuals; doubling time shortened to 2.1 weeks and FWHM to 9.7 weeks. Manitoba’s R eff , 0 increased to 1.8 and S eff , 0 to 1,038 individuals, while doubling time shortened to 2.6 weeks and FWHM to 13.0 weeks. Interpretation Alberta’s smaller second wave combined the highest effective reproduction number with the shortest doubling time and peak duration, demonstrating that limited outbreak size can coexist with rapid transmission. Joint estimates of transmission intensity, epidemic pace, peak duration, and effective susceptible population provide complementary measures for comparing outbreaks and informing public-health planning. Together, these estimates provide a quantitative basis for distinguishing transmission intensity from the scale of susceptible involvement, supporting comparisons across outbreaks and informing the timing and scale of public-health responses for future outbreaks.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在通过量化 2025-2026 年五个省 麻疹 浪潮中 麻疹 强度和规模的差异,了解加拿大 麻疹 消除状况的丧失。强调了免疫缺口集中的人群的脆弱性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用常见的易感者-暴露-感染-恢复 (SEIR) 模型来拟合 2025 年安大略省以及 2025 年和 2026 年阿尔伯塔省和马尼托巴省每周报告的 麻疹 发病率 数据。
elements_zh.methods: SEIR 模型适合每周报告的 麻疹 发病率 数据,固定平均潜伏期和感染期分别为 10 天和 8 天。估计有效繁殖数 (R_eff,0)、有效易感人群 (S_eff,0) 和初始感染数,以评估省份和特定波次的原发病例模型估计。
elements_zh.main_results: 安大略省的 R_eff,0 为 1.9,有 3,101 名有效易感个体,倍增时间为 2.4 周,峰值 FWHM 为 12.3 周。阿尔伯塔省和曼尼托巴省的 R_eff,0 值相似,分别为 1.9 和 1.5,但有效易感人群和倍增时间各不相同。2026 年,阿尔伯塔省的 R_eff,0 增加到 2.1,而曼尼托巴省则增加到 1.8。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 阿尔伯塔省较小的第二波具有最高的有效繁殖数、最短的倍增时间和峰值持续时间,这表明有限的 暴发 大小可以与快速的 传播 共存。对 传播 强度、流行速度、高峰持续时间和有效易感人群的联合估计为比较 传播 和为公共卫生规划提供信息提供了补充措施。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些估计为区分 传播 强度与易感性参与规模提供了定量基础,支持 传播 之间的比较,并告知未来 传播 公共卫生应对的时间和规模。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的设计局限性包括在不同省份使用通用的 SEIR 模型以及固定的平均潜伏期和传染期。证据强度中等,因为模型估计基于报告的 发病率 数据,并且没有考虑所有潜在的混杂因素。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 阿尔伯塔省较小的第二波具有最高的有效繁殖数、最短的倍增时间和峰值持续时间,这表明有限的 暴发 大小可以与快速的 传播 共存。对 传播 强度、流行速度、高峰持续时间和有效易感人群的联合估计为比较 传播 和为公共卫生规划提供信息提供了补充措施。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些估计为区分 传播 强度与易感性参与规模提供了定量基础,支持 传播 之间的比较,并告知未来 传播 公共卫生应对的时间和规模。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的设计局限性包括在不同省份使用通用的 SEIR 模型以及固定的平均潜伏期和传染期。证据强度中等,因为模型估计基于报告的 发病率 数据,并且没有考虑所有潜在的混杂因素。

title: SVIR Model Analysis of Measles with Incomplete Vaccination and 1 Waning Immunity: Sidoarjo-Indonesia Case
abstract: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.
journal: CAUCHY: Jurnal Matematika Murni dan Aplikasi

title_zh: 具有不完整 疫苗接种 和 1 个免疫力减弱的 麻疹 的 SVIR 模型分析:Sidoarjo-Indonesia 案例
source_body_en: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. abstract_zh: 麻疹仍然是印度尼西亚的重大公共卫生挑战,尤其是在疫苗接种覆盖率异质性和免疫力下降的地区。本研究开发并分析了一个针对麻疹传播的易感-接种-感染-康复(SVIR)分组模型,该模型纳入了免疫力下降的因素。基本再生数R0是通过下一代矩阵方法推导的,并且通过李雅普诺夫函数严格证明了无病平衡态和地方性平衡态的全局稳定性。模型参数是从2023年Sidoarjo市每周的监测数据中使用粒子群优化(PSO)、扩展卡尔曼滤波、最大似然估计和最小二乘法进行估计,并通过平均绝对百分比误差(MAPE)进行评估。PSO方法实现了最低的MAPE(11.17%),优于其他方法。估计的R0 = 0.668确认了无病状态。归一化敏感性分析确定疫苗效力是最关键的参数;疫苗效力下降至0 .75会使R0接近临界阈值,任何进一步的减少都会使系统进入地方性状态。这些发现强调了通过加强剂接种计划和强化疫苗接种策略保持高疫苗效力的必要性,以在区级维持麻疹的消除。

title: Protracted measles outbreak in a refugee-hosting setting in Kamwenge District, Uganda, 2025
abstract: Measles outbreaks continue to occur in Uganda despite measles-rubella (MR) vaccination. On 24 June 2025, Kamwenge District, a refugee-hosting area, reported three laboratory-confirmed measles cases. We investigated the outbreak to determine its magnitude, identify risk factors, and estimate vaccine effectiveness (VE), and vaccination coverage (VC). A suspected case was fever and generalized maculopapular rash with ≥ 1 of cough, coryza, or conjunctivitis among Kamwenge residents from 1 February to 7 July 2025; a confirmed case had measles-specific IgM. Cases were identified through health-facility records and community searches. We calculated attack rates (AR), conducted environmental assessments, and performed an age-matched case-control study using neighborhood controls. Conditional logistic regression estimated adjusted odds ratios (aORs). VE was calculated as (1−OR_ M−H )×100; VC was the proportion of vaccinated eligible controls. We identified 109 cases (3 confirmed, 106 suspected); no deaths occurred. Of the cases, 48.6% were refugees. Overall AR was 3.2/10,000, highest among children aged 9–17 months (30.8/10,000) and refugees (13.3/10,000). Among 73 cases and 167 controls, attending a place of worship was associated with infection (aOR = 11.1; 95% CI 3.5–35.1), while MR1 (aOR = 0.3; 95% CI 0.1–0.7) and MR2 (aOR = 0.05; 95% CI 0.01–0.3) were protective. VE was 93% for MR1 and 95% for MR2. Coverage among eligible controls was 67% for MR1 and 36% for MR2. A prolonged outbreak occurred amid low MR coverage and high-contact social mixing. Strengthening routine two-dose vaccination, targeted vaccination in refugee-hosting communities, and prompt isolation of suspected cases may help prevent future outbreaks.

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究于 2025 年 2 月 1 日至 7 月 7 日在难民收容区 Kamwenge 区进行。研究涉及 73 例病例和 167 例对照,病例是通过卫生设施记录和社区搜索发现的。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果表明,在难民收容社区加强常规两剂 疫苗接种 和针对性 疫苗接种 可能有助于预防未来的 暴发。迅速隔离疑似病例也被强调为一项重要的公共卫生措施。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据因其对卫生设施记录和社区搜索的依赖而受到限制,这可能会引入回忆偏差。由于可能存在漏报和样本量较小,因此调查结果的可信度为中等。

title: Zero-dose children and measles risk in Punjab, Pakistan: magnitude, geographic distribution, and programmatic implications, 2022–2026
abstract: Background Zero-dose children, defined by absence of a first diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis-containing dose, are the priority of the Immunization Agenda 2030. Measles cases include many unvaccinated children, but those too young for vaccination are rarely separated from those the programme could have reached. We describe the magnitude, age, and geographic distribution of measles zero-dose status among confirmed cases in Punjab, Pakistan. Methods We analysed 19,569 laboratory-confirmed and epidemiologically linked measles cases among 73,223 surveillance records, epidemiological week 1 of 2022 to week 25 of 2026. Measles zero-dose meant no measles-containing dose through routine or campaign immunization. Cases were split into vaccine-ineligible (under 9 months) and eligible (9 months or older). Analyses included trend tests, Spearman correlation, and adjusted Poisson regression. Results Of 19,569 cases, 9706 (50%) were zero-dose, and 5740 of these (59%) were infants under 9 months. Among 13,825 vaccine-eligible cases, 3963 (29%; 95% CI 28–29) were zero-dose: 21% in 2022, 40% in 2024, and 17% in 2026. Dera Ghazi Khan (59%) and Lodhran (52%) had the highest district shares, unrelated to administrative MCV1 coverage (rho = −0.24, p = 0.15). Case fatality was 0.71% in zero-dose and 0.26% in vaccinated eligible cases (adjusted relative risk 2.65, 95% CI 1.52–4.60). Conclusions About three in ten cases were too young for vaccination, and about three in ten of the rest had never received a measles dose. Cases over-represent unvaccinated children, so these proportions guide field investigation, not prevalence. District prioritisation should combine counts and proportions, not administrative coverage.

title_zh: 巴基斯坦旁遮普邦的零剂量儿童和 麻疹 风险:程度、地理分布和规划影响,2022-2026 年
source_body_en: Background Zero-dose children, defined by absence of a first diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis-containing dose, are the priority of the Immunization Agenda 2030. Measles cases include many unvaccinated children, but those too young for vaccination are rarely separated from those the programme could have reached. We describe the magnitude, age, and geographic distribution of measles zero-dose status among confirmed cases in Punjab, Pakistan. Methods We analysed 19,569 laboratory-confirmed and epidemiologically linked measles cases among 73,223 surveillance records, epidemiological week 1 of 2022 to week 25 of 2026. Measles zero-dose meant no measles-containing dose through routine or campaign immunization. Cases were split into vaccine-ineligible (under 9 months) and eligible (9 months or older). Analyses included trend tests, Spearman correlation, and adjusted Poisson regression. Results Of 19,569 cases, 9706 (50%) were zero-dose, and 5740 of these (59%) were infants under 9 months. Among 13,825 vaccine-eligible cases, 3963 (29%; 95% CI 28–29) were zero-dose: 21% in 2022, 40% in 2024, and 17% in 2026. Dera Ghazi Khan (59%) and Lodhran (52%) had the highest district shares, unrelated to administrative MCV1 coverage (rho = −0.24, p = 0.15). Case fatality was 0.71% in zero-dose and 0.26% in vaccinated eligible cases (adjusted relative risk 2.65, 95% CI 1.52–4.60). Conclusions About three in ten cases were too young for vaccination, and about three in ten of the rest had never received a measles dose. Cases over-represent unvaccinated children, so these proportions guide field investigation, not prevalence. District prioritisation should combine counts and proportions, not administrative coverage.

title: Prevalence of second-dose measles vaccination utilization and associated factors among MCV1-vaccinated children aged 15–36 months in Tocha Woreda, Dawuro Zone, Southwest Ethiopia, 2025
abstract: Background Measles is a highly contagious viral disease and a leading cause of morbidity and mortality among children worldwide. Evidence regarding the utilization of the second dose of the measles-containing vaccine (MCV2) and its associated factors in Southwest Ethiopia remains limited. This study examined MCV2 utilization rates and the factors associated with its uptake in Tocha Woreda, Dawuro Zone. Methods A community-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 585 children aged 15–36 months who had received the first dose of the measles-containing vaccine (MCV1). Participants were selected using a multi-stage systematic sampling method. Data were collected through in-person interviews with mothers or caregivers, using a structured questionnaire administered via the Kobo Collect mobile application. Data were analyzed using Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS) version 27.0. Descriptive statistics summarized participant characteristics. Bi-variable logistic regression identified candidate variables ( p < 0.25) for inclusion in a multivariable logistic regression model to identify independent predictors of MCV2 utilization. Statistical significance was defined as a p -value of <0.05. Multicollinearity was assessed using variance inflation factors, and model fit was evaluated using the Hosmer–Lemeshow goodness-of-fit test. Results Among the 585 children included (response rate: 94.4%), 67.2% (95% CI: 63–71%) received the second dose of measles vaccine. Urban residence [adjusted odds ratio (AOR) = 3.43; 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.74–6.44], maternal or caregiver education at the college level or higher (AOR = 12.76; 95% CI: 4.39–20.64), participation in conferences for pregnant women (AOR = 2.25; 95% CI: 1.11–4.56), shorter vaccination waiting times (≤15 min: AOR = 4.28; 95% CI: 1.83–10.01; 15–30 min: AOR = 3.33; 95% CI: 1.35–8.16), and favorable caregiver attitudes (AOR = 6.05; 95% CI: 2.96–12.35) were significantly associated with MCV2 utilization. Conclusion MCV2 utilization in Tocha Woreda remains below the World Health Organization (WHO) target for measles elimination. Improving maternal education, strengthening conferences for pregnant women, reducing waiting times at vaccination sites, and enhancing caregiver attitudes are essential to increasing MCV2 coverage.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 麻疹 是一种高度传染性的病毒性疾病,也是全球儿童发病和 死亡率 的主要原因。关于在埃塞俄比亚西南部使用第二剂含有 麻疹 的 疫苗 (MCV2) 及其相关因素的证据仍然有限。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Measles is a highly contagious viral disease and a leading cause of morbidity and mortality among children worldwide. Evidence regarding the utilization of the second dose of the measles-containing vaccine (MCV2) and its associated factors in Southwest Ethiopia remains limited.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A community-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 585 children aged 15–36 months who had received the first dose of the measles-containing vaccine (MCV1). Participants were selected using a multi-stage systematic sampling method.
analysis_en.methods: Data were collected through in-person interviews with mothers or caregivers, using a structured questionnaire administered via the Kobo Collect mobile application. Bi-variable logistic regression identified candidate variables (p < 0.25) for inclusion in a multivariable logistic regression model to identify independent predictors of MCV2 utilization. Data were analyzed using Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS) version 27.0. Descriptive statistics summarized participant characteristics. Multicollinearity was assessed using variance inflation factors, and model fit was evaluated using the Hosmer–Lemeshow goodness-of-fit test.
analysis_en.main_results: Among the 585 children included (response rate: 94.4%), 67.2% (95% CI: 63–71%) received the second dose of measles vaccine. Urban residence [adjusted odds ratio (AOR) = 3.43; 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.74–6.44], maternal or caregiver education at the college level or higher (AOR = 12.76; 95% CI: 4.39–20.64), participation in conferences for pregnant women (AOR = 2.25; 95% CI: 1.11–4.56), shorter vaccination waiting times (≤15 min: AOR = 4.28; 95% CI: 1.83–10.01; 15–30 min: AOR = 3.33; 95% CI: 1.35–8.16), and favorable caregiver attitudes (AOR = 6.05; 95% CI: 2.96–12.35) were significantly associated with MCV2 utilization.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study identified factors significantly associated with MCV2 utilization, including urban residence, higher maternal education, participation in pregnant women conferences, shorter waiting times, and favorable caregiver attitudes. These findings highlight the importance of addressing these factors to improve vaccination coverage.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Improving maternal education, strengthening conferences for pregnant women, reducing waiting times at vaccination sites, and enhancing caregiver attitudes are essential to increasing MCV2 coverage. These findings can inform targeted public health interventions to improve measles vaccination rates in the region.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which cannot establish causality. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the reliance on self-reported data and the potential for confounding factors.

title_zh: 2025 年埃塞俄比亚西南部达乌罗地区 Tocha Woreda 15-36 个月 MCV1 疫苗接种儿童第二剂 麻疹 患病率 的利用情况及相关因素
source_body_en: Background Measles is a highly contagious viral disease and a leading cause of morbidity and mortality among children worldwide. Evidence regarding the utilization of the second dose of the measles-containing vaccine (MCV2) and its associated factors in Southwest Ethiopia remains limited. This study examined MCV2 utilization rates and the factors associated with its uptake in Tocha Woreda, Dawuro Zone. Methods A community-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 585 children aged 15–36 months who had received the first dose of the measles-containing vaccine (MCV1). Participants were selected using a multi-stage systematic sampling method. Data were collected through in-person interviews with mothers or caregivers, using a structured questionnaire administered via the Kobo Collect mobile application. Data were analyzed using Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS) version 27.0. Descriptive statistics summarized participant characteristics. Bi-variable logistic regression identified candidate variables ( p < 0.25) for inclusion in a multivariable logistic regression model to identify independent predictors of MCV2 utilization. Statistical significance was defined as a p -value of <0.05. Multicollinearity was assessed using variance inflation factors, and model fit was evaluated using the Hosmer–Lemeshow goodness-of-fit test. Results Among the 585 children included (response rate: 94.4%), 67.2% (95% CI: 63–71%) received the second dose of measles vaccine. Urban residence [adjusted odds ratio (AOR) = 3.43; 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.74–6.44], maternal or caregiver education at the college level or higher (AOR = 12.76; 95% CI: 4.39–20.64), participation in conferences for pregnant women (AOR = 2.25; 95% CI: 1.11–4.56), shorter vaccination waiting times (≤15 min: AOR = 4.28; 95% CI: 1.83–10.01; 15–30 min: AOR = 3.33; 95% CI: 1.35–8.16), and favorable caregiver attitudes (AOR = 6.05; 95% CI: 2.96–12.35) were significantly associated with MCV2 utilization. Conclusion MCV2 utilization in Tocha Woreda remains below the World Health Organization (WHO) target for measles elimination. Improving maternal education, strengthening conferences for pregnant women, reducing waiting times at vaccination sites, and enhancing caregiver attitudes are essential to increasing MCV2 coverage.

title: Analysis of a reaction-diffusion SVEIR model for measles geographic spread
abstract: We formulate and analyze a deterministic reaction-diffusion SVEIR model for the geographic spread of measles, explicitly incorporating vaccination, vaccine efficacy, latency, recovery, demographic turnover, and spatial diffusion. The disease-free equilibrium and the basic reproduction number $$\mathcal {R}_0$$ are obtained using the next-generation matrix, and linear stability analysis identifies the invasion threshold and the critical spatial mode. Because the critical wavenumber is zero, a long-wavelength analysis is used to characterize slow spatial variation near the invasion front. A mathematical consistency check shows that the common-diffusion formulation does not support a finite-wavenumber Turing instability; the roll, square, and hexagonal modes are therefore presented only as generic pattern-theory modes rather than as patterns proved to arise from the present model. Numerical simulations illustrate spatiotemporal propagation and quantify the effects of vaccine efficacy, vaccination rate, and transmission intensity.

title_zh: 麻疹 地理分布的反应扩散 SVEIR 模型分析
source_body_en: We formulate and analyze a deterministic reaction-diffusion SVEIR model for the geographic spread of measles, explicitly incorporating vaccination, vaccine efficacy, latency, recovery, demographic turnover, and spatial diffusion. The disease-free equilibrium and the basic reproduction number $$\mathcal {R}_0$$ are obtained using the next-generation matrix, and linear stability analysis identifies the invasion threshold and the critical spatial mode. Because the critical wavenumber is zero, a long-wavelength analysis is used to characterize slow spatial variation near the invasion front. A mathematical consistency check shows that the common-diffusion formulation does not support a finite-wavenumber Turing instability; the roll, square, and hexagonal modes are therefore presented only as generic pattern-theory modes rather than as patterns proved to arise from the present model. Numerical simulations illustrate spatiotemporal propagation and quantify the effects of vaccine efficacy, vaccination rate, and transmission intensity.
abstract_zh: 我们针对 麻疹 的地理分布制定并分析了确定性反应扩散 SVEIR 模型,明确纳入了 疫苗接种、疫苗 功效、潜伏期、恢复、人口流动和空间扩散。使用下一代矩阵获得无病平衡和基本繁殖数$$\mathcal {R}_0$$,并通过线性稳定性分析确定入侵阈值和临界空间模式。由于临界波数为零,因此使用长波长分析来表征入侵前沿附近的缓慢空间变化。数学一致性检查表明,共扩散公式不支持有限波数图灵不稳定性;因此,滚动模式、方形模式和六边形模式仅作为通用模式理论模式提出,而不是作为被证明从当前模型产生的模式。数值模拟说明了时空传播并量化了 疫苗 功效、疫苗接种 速率和 传播 强度的影响。

title: Declining Measles Vaccination Coverage and Measles Resurgence in the Americas: A Systematic Review of Associations with Incidence and Outbreaks
abstract: This systematic review examines the association between insufficient or declining population-level measles vaccination coverage and measles incidence or outbreak occurrence in the Americas. The review focuses on observational epidemiological evidence, including ecological, longitudinal, and spatial analyses using observed vaccination coverage and measles outcomes. Searches were conducted in PubMed/MEDLINE, LILACS, and SciELO, covering publications from November 2, 2016, to November 2, 2026. The review includes evidence from national and subnational populations and considers statistically significant and non-significant associations. Bibliographic screening has been conducted, and the eligibility and quantitative findings of candidate studies are being verified. Final risk-of-bias assessment and evidence synthesis remain in progress.

title: Not Immune After All: Polymerase Chain Reaction–Confirmed Measles in a Presumed-Immune 70-Year-Old Returning Traveler
abstract: Measles is an increasingly important consideration in adults with febrile rash illness, particularly after international travel. We report a 70-year-old woman who developed measles following travel to Israel despite presumed immunity based on age and a reported history of childhood infection. She presented with fever, cough, and rash, followed by cephalocaudal progression of the rash, conjunctival injection, and oral lesions. Oropharyngeal polymerase chain reaction confirmed measles; serum IgG was negative. This case highlights limitations of presumed immunity and the importance of early diagnosis, isolation, and public health notification.
journal: Annals of Internal Medicine Clinical Cases

title: Hemagglutinin and fusion proteins precede measles virus ribonucleoproteins and marshal cell-to-cell spread in airway epithelium
abstract: ABSTRACT Measles virus (MeV) is the most contagious human respiratory pathogen. To understand how it spreads in the airways, we infected well-differentiated primary cultures of human airway epithelial cells (HAE). We discovered that the MeV attachment protein (hemagglutinin, H), the fusion (F) protein, and the assembly organizer protein (matrix, M) reach newly infected cells ahead of, and independently from, the replicative complex proteins. To characterize the mechanisms of MeV spread, we generated a replication-deficient adenoviral vector expressing the MeV M, F, and H proteins in a doxycycline-inducible manner. This viral vector formed infectious centers that preserved epithelial function like those from MeV infection. To further dissect this process, we generated Ad vectors expressing individual MeV proteins, termed Ad-M, Ad-F, and Ad-H. Transduction of HAE with single, double, and triple Ad vector combinations revealed that Ad-F and Ad-H are necessary and sufficient to form MeV-like infectious centers. MeV enters and spreads within airway epithelia via H protein binding to adherens junction protein, nectin-4. To disrupt spread, we introduced the point mutation H Y543A , a mutation previously described to inhibit nectin-4 binding, in the Ad-H vector. Co-transduction of Ad-F and Ad-H Y543A did not result in MeV-like infectious center formation. Finally, we assessed whether the MeV-related paramyxovirus Nipah (NiV) attachment and fusion proteins (G and F, respectively) support cell-to-cell spread. Co-transduction of HAE with Ad-NiV-G and Ad-NiV-F did not result in infectious center formation, suggesting that decoupling of the membrane fusion apparatus function from replication is a unique feature of the MeV envelope glycoproteins. IMPORTANCE Measles virus is a highly contagious pathogen. We characterized a mechanism by which measles virus spreads rapidly through the cells that line the human airway in an ex vivo model. We show that the proteins of the viral membrane fusion apparatus, hemagglutinin (H) and fusion (F), move independently from and reach newly infected cells before the proteins of the replicative complex. Thus, viral protein spread is assembled and arranged in order (i.e., marshaled ). Using adenovirus-based vectors, we show that co-expression of H and F proteins promotes rapid sequential spread to multiple cells and the formation of infectious centers. Further elucidation of the mechanism of measles virus amplification and cell-to-cell spread within the lung may help explain its highly contagious nature.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the mechanism of measles virus (MeV) spread in human airway epithelial cells (HAE). The research question focuses on understanding how MeV spreads through the airways, which is critical given its status as the most contagious human respiratory pathogen. The study design involves infecting HAE with MeV and using replication-deficient adenoviral vectors to express MeV proteins. The main results show that the hemagglutinin (H) and fusion (F) proteins are necessary and sufficient to form MeV-like infectious centers, while the replicative complex proteins arrive later. The authors interpret these findings as evidence of a sequential and ordered spread of viral proteins, which may explain the virus's high contagiousness. The study's significance lies in its potential to inform future research on MeV transmission and prevention. The evidence strength is moderate due to the ex vivo model and lack of in vivo data.

abstract_zh: 摘要 麻疹病毒 (MeV) 是最具传染性的人类呼吸道病原体。为了了解它如何在气道中传播,我们感染了分化良好的人气道上皮细胞(HAE)的原代培养物。我们发现 MeV 附着蛋白(血凝素,H)、融合蛋白(F)和组装组织蛋白(基质,M)先于复制复合体蛋白到达新感染的细胞,并且独立于复制复合体蛋白。为了表征 MeV 传播的机制,我们生成了复制缺陷型腺病毒 媒介,它以多西环素诱导的方式表达 MeV M、F 和 H 蛋白。这种病毒 媒介 形成了感染中心,保留了与 MeV 感染类似的上皮功能。为了进一步剖析这个过程,我们生成了表达单个 MeV 蛋白的 Ad 媒介,称为 Ad-M、Ad-F 和 Ad-H。用单、双和三 Ad 媒介 组合转导 HAE 表明,Ad-F 和 Ad-H 对于形成 MeV 样感染中心是必要且充分的。MeV 通过 H 蛋白与粘附连接蛋白 nectin-4 结合进入气道上皮并在气道上皮内传播。为了破坏传播,我们在 Ad-H 媒介 中引入了点 突变 H Y543A,这是先前描述的抑制 nectin-4 结合的 突变。Ad-F和Ad-H Y543A的共转导没有导致MeV样感染中心的形成。最后,我们评估了 MeV 相关副粘病毒尼帕 (NiV) 附着蛋白和融合蛋白(分别为 G 和 F)是否支持细胞间传播。HAE 与 Ad-NiV-G 和 Ad-NiV-F 的共转导不会导致感染中心的形成,这表明膜融合装置功能与复制的解偶联是 MeV 包膜糖蛋白的独特特征。重要性 麻疹病毒 是一种高度传染性的病原体。我们在离体模型中描述了 麻疹病毒 在人体气道内细胞中快速传播的机制。我们表明,病毒膜融合装置的蛋白质,血凝素(H)和融合蛋白(F),独立于复制复合物的蛋白质移动并先到达新感染的细胞。因此,病毒蛋白传播按顺序组装和排列(即编组)。使用基于腺病毒的 媒介,我们发现 H 和 F 蛋白的共表达促进快速顺序传播到多个细胞和感染中心的形成。进一步阐明 麻疹病毒 肺部扩增和细胞间传播的机制可能有助于解释其高度传染性。

analysis_zh.methods: 为了表征 MeV 传播的机制,我们生成了复制缺陷型腺病毒 媒介,它以多西环素诱导的方式表达 MeV M、F 和 H 蛋白。我们还生成了表达单个 MeV 蛋白的 Ad 媒介,称为 Ad-M、Ad-F 和 Ad-H,以进一步剖析这一过程。
analysis_zh.main_results: 用单、双和三 Ad 媒介 组合转导 HAE 表明,Ad-F 和 Ad-H 对于形成 MeV 样感染中心是必要且充分的。HAE 与 Ad-NiV-G 和 Ad-NiV-F 的共转导不会导致感染中心的形成。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 我们表明,病毒膜融合装置的蛋白质,血凝素(H)和融合蛋白(F),独立于复制复合物的蛋白质移动并先到达新感染的细胞。因此,病毒蛋白传播按顺序组装和排列(即编组)。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 进一步阐明 麻疹病毒 肺部扩增和细胞间传播的机制可能有助于解释其高度传染性。这可能为未来关于 麻疹病毒 传播 和预防策略的研究提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告局限性。该研究基于离体模型,不包括体内数据,这可能会限制普遍性。信心程度适中。

title: Nectin-4 mediates rubella virus entry in airway and placental cells
abstract: Abstract Rubella virus (RuV) causes rubella and, when acquired during pregnancy, congenital rubella syndrome (CRS). Despite its clinical significance, the cellular entry mechanism of RuV remains poorly characterized owing to limited knowledge of host receptors, hampering pathogenesis studies and therapeutic development. Here, we identify Nectin-4 as a functional RuV entry receptor through proximity biotin labeling-based proteomics coupled with CRISPR/Cas9 validation. Notably, Nectin-4 is shared with measles virus, revealing convergent evolution in viral entry despite the different viral families. Nectin-4 directly interacts with the RuV envelope glycoproteins through its ectodomain, facilitating receptor-mediated endocytosis following initial calcium-dependent viral attachment. In polarized respiratory epithelial cells, Nectin-4 mediates basolateral viral entry and subsequent apical release of progeny virions, enabling efficient respiratory transmission. Using human placental organoid models, we demonstrate that syncytiotrophoblasts serve as primary targets for transplacental RuV infection, with viral entry significantly inhibited by Nectin-4 blockade. These findings establish Nectin-4 as critical for both horizontal respiratory transmission and vertical maternal–fetal transmission of RuV. Our results provide fundamental insights into RuV pathogenesis and identify Nectin-4 as a promising therapeutic target for CRS. Importantly, the discovery of shared receptor utilization between RuV and measles virus opens new avenues for integrated elimination strategies targeting both pathogens.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the lack of understanding regarding the cellular entry mechanism of measles virus, which has hindered pathogenesis studies and therapeutic development.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research utilized proximity biotin labeling-based proteomics combined with CRISPR/Cas9 validation to identify the measles virus entry receptor. It also included human placental organoid models to examine transplacental infection.
analysis.methods: The study employed proximity biotin labeling-based proteomics to identify potential receptors and CRISPR/Cas9 validation to confirm their functionality. Human placental organoid models were used to assess viral entry and transmission.
analysis.main_results: Nectin-4 was identified as a functional measles virus entry receptor. In placental organoids, viral entry was significantly inhibited by Nectin-4 blockade.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings reveal that Nectin-4 is critical for both respiratory and transplacental measles virus transmission, offering new insights into the virus's pathogenesis.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The identification of Nectin-4 as a receptor provides a foundation for developing targeted therapies and improving strategies for measles virus prevention and control.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-level evidence, and the findings are based on in vitro models, which may not fully represent in vivo conditions. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study identifies Nectin-4 as a functional receptor for measles virus entry, highlighting its role in both respiratory and transplacentally transmitted infections. The research uses proximity biotin labeling and CRISPR/Cas9 validation to confirm Nectin-4's involvement in viral entry, with in vitro human placental organoid models demonstrating its significance in transplacental infection. These findings offer new insights into measles virus pathogenesis and suggest potential therapeutic targets for preventing congenital rubella syndrome. However, the study is based on abstract-level evidence and in vitro models, which may limit its generalizability. The results are relevant for improving surveillance, diagnosis, and treatment strategies for measles virus, but further research is needed to validate these findings in vivo.

title_zh: Nectin-4 介导风疹病毒进入气道和胎盘细胞

abstract_zh: 摘要 风疹病毒 (RuV) 会引起风疹,如果在怀孕期间感染,则会引起先天性风疹综合征 (CRS)。尽管具有临床意义,但由于对 宿主 受体的了解有限,RuV 的细胞进入机制仍然知之甚少,这阻碍了 发病机制 的研究和治疗开发。在这里,我们通过基于邻近生物素标记的蛋白质组学结合 CRISPR/Cas9 验证,将 Nectin-4 确定为功能性 RuV 进入受体。值得注意的是,Nectin-4 与 麻疹病毒 共享,揭示了尽管病毒家族不同,但病毒进入过程中 麻疹病毒 趋同。Nectin-4 通过其胞外域直接与 RuV 包膜糖蛋白相互作用,在最初的钙依赖性病毒附着后促进受体介导的内吞作用。在极化的呼吸道上皮细胞中,Nectin-4 介导基底外侧病毒进入和随后子代病毒粒子的顶端释放,从而实现高效的呼吸道 传播。使用人胎盘类器官模型,我们证明合体滋养层是经胎盘 RuV 感染的主要目标,Nectin-4 阻断可显着抑制病毒进入。这些发现表明,Nectin-4 对于 RuV 的水平呼吸 传播 和垂直母胎 传播 至关重要。我们的结果提供了对 RuV 发病机制 的基本见解,并将 Nectin-4 确定为 CRS 的有前途的治疗靶点。重要的是,RuV 和 麻疹病毒 之间共享受体利用的发现为针对这两种病原体的综合消除策略开辟了新途径。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the ongoing measles crisis in Bangladesh, highlighting the need to understand the disease's impact and the challenges in its prevention.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is an editorial analyzing the measles situation in Bangladesh, focusing on the disease's prevalence and the factors contributing to its persistence in the region.
analysis.methods: The editorial reviews existing literature and reports on measles outbreaks, vaccine coverage, and public health responses in Bangladesh without detailing specific methodologies or data collection procedures.
analysis.main_results: The editorial notes that measles remains a preventable crisis in Bangladesh due to low vaccination rates and gaps in disease surveillance.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as a call to action for improving measles control strategies in Bangladesh, emphasizing the need for better surveillance and vaccination programs.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the importance of strengthening measles surveillance and immunization efforts in Bangladesh to prevent outbreaks and reduce disease burden.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is based on an abstract-only review, which limits the depth of analysis and the strength of the conclusions drawn.

analysis.summary_en: The editorial 'Measles in Bangladesh: A Preventable Crisis' highlights the ongoing challenges of measles control in the country, emphasizing low vaccination rates and gaps in surveillance as key factors. It calls for improved strategies to prevent outbreaks and reduce the disease burden. The analysis is based on an abstract-only review, which limits the depth of findings and the strength of conclusions. The study serves as a reminder of the importance of targeted public health interventions to address the preventable nature of measles in Bangladesh.

title: Multiple Sclerosis and Viruses: « Liaisons Dangereuses ».
abstract: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a complex, multifactorial neurodegenerative disease with an aetiology that is still partially elusive. Several risk factors are associated with MS development including genetic predisposition and various environmental stressors; however, recently, viral infections have gained significant attention as a crucial environmental trigger. Despite the well-established link between Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) and MS susceptibility, a single-pathogen model fails to clearly characterise the molecular cascades driving the disease, suggesting that the transition from infection to autoimmune response involves more than one viral agent. In this review we examine the speculation that the interactions among different neurotropic viruses could serve a collective causative role in MS, which is under-researched in the literature at present. We summarise contradictory evidence on the role of different viral agents, including the Herpesviridae family (Human Cytomegalovirus, EBV, Herpes Simplex Viruses HSV-1 and HSV-2, and Varicella Zoster Virus), Paramyxoviridae family (Measles Virus and Rubella Virus), Influenza virus, SARS-CoV-2, and Human Endogenous Retroviruses (HERVs). Through interplay within shared molecular pathways, immune modulation, and activation of latent infections, these viruses may collectively influence the inflammatory and demyelinating processes that characterise MS. This review evaluates the etiological role of viral interplay in MS through the cumulative and interactive effects of these pathogens. The available epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data converge on the concept that viral co-exposures act synergistically to shape MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. Characterising these viral interactions presents a new research direction for the identification of novel biomarkers and the development of preventative strategies through the targeted control of viral networks.

title_zh: 多发性硬化症和病毒:《危险关系》。
source_body_en: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a complex, multifactorial neurodegenerative disease with an aetiology that is still partially elusive. Several risk factors are associated with MS development including genetic predisposition and various environmental stressors; however, recently, viral infections have gained significant attention as a crucial environmental trigger. Despite the well-established link between Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) and MS susceptibility, a single-pathogen model fails to clearly characterise the molecular cascades driving the disease, suggesting that the transition from infection to autoimmune response involves more than one viral agent. In this review we examine the speculation that the interactions among different neurotropic viruses could serve a collective causative role in MS, which is under-researched in the literature at present. We summarise contradictory evidence on the role of different viral agents, including the Herpesviridae family (Human Cytomegalovirus, EBV, Herpes Simplex Viruses HSV-1 and HSV-2, and Varicella Zoster Virus), Paramyxoviridae family (Measles Virus and Rubella Virus), Influenza virus, SARS-CoV-2, and Human Endogenous Retroviruses (HERVs). Through interplay within shared molecular pathways, immune modulation, and activation of latent infections, these viruses may collectively influence the inflammatory and demyelinating processes that characterise MS. This review evaluates the etiological role of viral interplay in MS through the cumulative and interactive effects of these pathogens. The available epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data converge on the concept that viral co-exposures act synergistically to shape MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. Characterising these viral interactions presents a new research direction for the identification of novel biomarkers and the development of preventative strategies through the targeted control of viral networks.
abstract_zh: 多发性硬化症(MS)是一种复杂的、多因素的神经退行性疾病,其病因仍部分不明。与MS发病相关的风险因素包括遗传易感性和多种环境应激因素;然而,最近病毒感染引起了广泛关注,被认为是重要的环境诱因。尽管已知EB病毒(EBV)与MS易感性之间存在明确的关联,但单一病原体模型无法清晰描述驱动该疾病分子级联反应的机制,这表明从感染到自身免疫反应的转变可能涉及不止一种病毒。在本综述中,我们探讨了不同神经嗜性病毒之间的相互作用可能在MS中发挥协同致病作用的假设,这一领域目前在文献中研究较少。我们总结了不同病毒在MS发病中作用的矛盾证据,包括疱疹病毒科(人类巨细胞病毒、EB病毒、单纯疱疹病毒HSV-1和HSV-2,以及水痘-带状疱疹病毒)、副粘病毒科(麻疹病毒病毒和风疹病毒)、流感病毒、SARS-CoV-2以及人类内源性逆转录病毒(HERVs)。这些病毒可能通过在共享分子通路中的相互作用、免疫调节以及激活潜伏感染,共同影响MS中特征性的炎症和脱髓鞘过程。本综述评估了病毒相互作用在MS病因中的作用,通过这些病原体的累积和交互效应。现有的流行病学、免疫学和实验数据表明,病毒的共同暴露可能在遗传易感个体中协同影响MS的易感性。明确这些病毒相互作用为识别新型生物标志物和通过靶向控制病毒网络开发预防策略提供了新的研究方向。

title: Epidemiological Characteristics and Clinical Outcomes of Vaccine-associated Urticaria: A Retrospective Cross-sectional Analysis of the Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System Database (1990-2025).
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Urticaria is a commonly reported cutaneous adverse event following vaccination, which may range from mild self-limiting reactions to more severe hypersensitivity manifestations. Monitoring vaccine-associated urticaria is important for ongoing vaccine safety surveillance and pharmacovigilance. However, large-scale population-based analyses evaluating demographic characteristics, vaccine associations, onset intervals, and severity patterns remain limited. AIM: The aim of the study was to analyze reports of urticaria in the Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System (VAERS) database between 1990 and 2025 and evaluate demographic characteristics, vaccine type distribution, onset intervals, temporal trends, and seriousness patterns. METHODOLOGY: A retrospective observational study was conducted using data from the VAERS database. Reports of urticaria submitted between January 1990 and March 2025 were included. The variables analyzed included age, sex, vaccine type, onset interval, and seriousness classification. Descriptive statistics were generated using frequencies and percentages, and comparative analyses were performed between serious and nonserious reports. RESULTS: A total of 61,996 urticaria reports were identified during the study period. Most reports occurred among adults aged 18-49 years and females. Most reports were classified as nonserious and occurred within the early postvaccination period. COVID-19 vaccines accounted for the highest proportion of reports, followed by influenza and measles, mumps, and rubella vaccines. Temporal analysis demonstrated a marked increase in reporting during 2021, followed by declining trends thereafter. Comparative analysis identified differences in demographic and clinical characteristics between serious and nonserious reports. CONCLUSION: Urticaria is a frequently reported adverse event following vaccination, with identifiable demographic, temporal, and clinical patterns. Most reports were nonserious and occurred shortly after vaccination, although differences were observed between serious and nonserious reports. Continued pharmacovigilance and future studies incorporating detailed clinical data are needed to better understand factors associated with vaccine-related urticaria.

title_zh: 疫苗 相关荨麻疹的流行病学特征和临床结果:疫苗 不良事件报告系统数据库(1990-2025)的回顾性横断面分析。
source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Urticaria is a commonly reported cutaneous adverse event following vaccination, which may range from mild self-limiting reactions to more severe hypersensitivity manifestations. Monitoring vaccine-associated urticaria is important for ongoing vaccine safety surveillance and pharmacovigilance. However, large-scale population-based analyses evaluating demographic characteristics, vaccine associations, onset intervals, and severity patterns remain limited. AIM: The aim of the study was to analyze reports of urticaria in the Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System (VAERS) database between 1990 and 2025 and evaluate demographic characteristics, vaccine type distribution, onset intervals, temporal trends, and seriousness patterns. METHODOLOGY: A retrospective observational study was conducted using data from the VAERS database. Reports of urticaria submitted between January 1990 and March 2025 were included. The variables analyzed included age, sex, vaccine type, onset interval, and seriousness classification. Descriptive statistics were generated using frequencies and percentages, and comparative analyses were performed between serious and nonserious reports. RESULTS: A total of 61,996 urticaria reports were identified during the study period. Most reports occurred among adults aged 18-49 years and females. Most reports were classified as nonserious and occurred within the early postvaccination period. COVID-19 vaccines accounted for the highest proportion of reports, followed by influenza and measles, mumps, and rubella vaccines. Temporal analysis demonstrated a marked increase in reporting during 2021, followed by declining trends thereafter. Comparative analysis identified differences in demographic and clinical characteristics between serious and nonserious reports. CONCLUSION: Urticaria is a frequently reported adverse event following vaccination, with identifiable demographic, temporal, and clinical patterns. Most reports were nonserious and occurred shortly after vaccination, although differences were observed between serious and nonserious reports. Continued pharmacovigilance and future studies incorporating detailed clinical data are needed to better understand factors associated with vaccine-related urticaria.

title: Childhood vaccination in Mali: Determinants and differences between conflict-affected and non-conflict regions from the 2023-2024 Demographic and Health Survey.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Armed conflict may disrupt immunization services and increase barriers to childhood vaccination. This study examined determinants of full basic childhood vaccination in Mali and assessed whether they differed between conflict-affected and non-conflict regions. METHODS: We conducted a secondary analysis of the 2023-2024 Mali Demographic and Health Survey, including 2859 children aged 12-23 months. Full basic vaccination was defined as receipt of Bacille Calmette-Guérin vaccine, three doses of pentavalent vaccine, three doses of oral polio vaccine (excluding the birth dose), and measles vaccine. Survey-weighted logistic regression models were fitted nationally and separately for conflict-affected and non-conflict regions. Interactions between conflict status and selected explanatory variables were tested. RESULTS: Full basic vaccination coverage was 51.87%. Coverage did not differ significantly between conflict-affected and non-conflict regions (50.08% vs 52.64%; p = 0.467), and conflict status was not independently associated with vaccination after adjustment. Antenatal care attendance and facility-based delivery were consistently associated with higher odds of full vaccination. In conflict-affected regions, media exposure and shorter perceived distance to health facilities were also associated with higher vaccination uptake. A significant interaction was observed between conflict status and distance to health facility (p = 0.01). CONCLUSIONS: Childhood vaccination coverage in Mali remains suboptimal. Although overall coverage was similar across conflict and non-conflict regions, determinants differed by context, highlighting the need for tailored strategies to improve vaccine uptake.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the determinants of full basic childhood vaccination in Mali, focusing on differences between conflict-affected and non-conflict regions. The research aimed to understand how factors like antenatal care attendance, facility-based delivery, media exposure, and perceived distance to health facilities influence vaccination rates. The study used data from the 2023-2024 Demographic and Health Survey, analyzing 2859 children aged 12-23 months. Results showed that overall vaccination coverage was 51.87%, with no significant difference between conflict-affected and non-conflict regions. However, a significant interaction was found between conflict status and distance to health facilities. The authors concluded that while vaccination coverage is suboptimal, determinants vary by context, emphasizing the need for tailored strategies. The study's findings suggest that improving access to health facilities and promoting antenatal care and facility-based delivery could enhance vaccination rates, particularly in conflict-affected areas. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the lack of detailed limitations reported.

title_zh: 马里的童年 疫苗接种:2023-2024 年人口和健康调查中受冲突影响地区和非冲突地区之间的决定因素和差异。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Armed conflict may disrupt immunization services and increase barriers to childhood vaccination. This study examined determinants of full basic childhood vaccination in Mali and assessed whether they differed between conflict-affected and non-conflict regions. METHODS: We conducted a secondary analysis of the 2023-2024 Mali Demographic and Health Survey, including 2859 children aged 12-23 months. Full basic vaccination was defined as receipt of Bacille Calmette-Guérin vaccine, three doses of pentavalent vaccine, three doses of oral polio vaccine (excluding the birth dose), and measles vaccine. Survey-weighted logistic regression models were fitted nationally and separately for conflict-affected and non-conflict regions. Interactions between conflict status and selected explanatory variables were tested. RESULTS: Full basic vaccination coverage was 51.87%. Coverage did not differ significantly between conflict-affected and non-conflict regions (50.08% vs 52.64%; p = 0.467), and conflict status was not independently associated with vaccination after adjustment. Antenatal care attendance and facility-based delivery were consistently associated with higher odds of full vaccination. In conflict-affected regions, media exposure and shorter perceived distance to health facilities were also associated with higher vaccination uptake. A significant interaction was observed between conflict status and distance to health facility (p = 0.01). CONCLUSIONS: Childhood vaccination coverage in Mali remains suboptimal. Although overall coverage was similar across conflict and non-conflict regions, determinants differed by context, highlighting the need for tailored strategies to improve vaccine uptake.
abstract_zh: 背景:武装冲突可能会扰乱免疫服务并增加儿童 疫苗接种 的障碍。本研究调查了马里完整基础童年 疫苗接种 的决定因素,并评估了这些决定因素在受冲突影响地区和非冲突地区之间是否存在差异。方法:我们对 2023-2024 年马里人口和健康调查进行了二次分析,其中包括 2859 名 12-23 个月大的儿童。完全基本疫苗接种被定义为接受卡介苗疫苗、三剂五价疫苗、三剂口服脊髓灰质炎疫苗(不包括出生剂量)和麻疹 疫苗。调查加权逻辑回归模型在全国范围内分别针对受冲突影响和非冲突地区进行拟合。测试了冲突状态和选定的解释变量之间的相互作用。结果:疫苗接种 的基本基本覆盖率为 51.87%。受冲突影响地区和非冲突地区的覆盖范围没有显着差异(50.08% vs 52.64%;p = 0.467),调整后冲突状态与 疫苗接种 不独立相关。产前护理就诊率和设施分娩始终与较高的完全 疫苗接种 几率相关。在受冲突影响的地区,媒体曝光和距医疗机构的感知距离较短也与 疫苗接种 的使用率较高有关。观察到冲突状态和距医疗机构的距离之间存在显着的交互作用 (p = 0.01)。结论:马里的儿童 疫苗接种 覆盖率仍然不理想。尽管冲突地区和非冲突地区的总体覆盖范围相似,但决定因素因背景而异,凸显需要制定量身定制的策略来提高 疫苗 的采用率。

title: 990 Infectious complications following blinatumomab immunotherapy in paediatric B-ALL- A real-world analysis from a large tertiary cancer care centre in India
abstract: Background Blinatumomab’s mechanism of action induces T-cell activation and hypogammaglobulinemia which can predispose patients to infections. In LMICs, distinct environmental pathogen exposures, resource constraints, and baseline nutritional variations may amplify these risks. Real-world data regarding the infectious profile of blinatumomab in LMICs remains scarce. We aim to characterize the incidence, microbiological-spectrum, and clinical impact of infectious-complications during blinatumomab-therapy in a resource-constrained setting.Methods We conducted a retrospective cohort study of pediatric patients with relapsed/refractory B-ALL who received blinatumomab between May 2021 and March 2026 at TMH, Mumbai. Infectious episodes were captured from the initiation of blinatumomab until 60 days post-therapy and graded using CTCAE v 5.0. Clinical correlations with concomitant Cytokine Release Syndrome (CRS), Post therapy IgG Levels, and survival outcomes were analyzed.Results There were 105 patients eligible for analysis, of which 55 (52.4%) developed a febrile episode within 60 days of initiating treatment. Almost all of these (54/55) had infections and presented with systemic features in 46 (85%), and local manifestations in 8 (15%). In the latter group, half (4/8) were due to Central-line site related infection. Amongst 42 episodes of systemic infections, the most common sites were respiratory tract (n = 6,38.1%) and the bloodstream(n = 15,35.7%).There was one case of colitis-associated viraemia, one with acute suppurative otitis media (2.4%),while the primary anatomic site remained unspecified in the remaining 10 cases (23.8%). Viral etiologies were highly predominant in this subset, accounting for 50% (n = 21) of the episodes, with Measles being the most frequently isolated pathogen ( figure 1). All deaths were driven by viral pathogens, with vaccine-preventable diseases like Measles being the primary cause of death in 80% of cases (n = 4/5),due to Measles Encephalitis, and one death being due to Parainfluenzae-induced pneumonia.Conclusions Infections are common in pediatric B-ALL patients treated with blinatumomab and may occur in more than half the patients. Systemic viral pathogens predominate over bacterial in frequency and are almost exclusively responsible for mortality. Clinical severity of concomitant CRS (≥ Grade 2) and lower IgG levels correlate with infectious vulnerability. All mortality observed was in vaccine-preventable diseases. While falling community vaccination rates may be responsible for localized outbreaks, targeted interventions including influenza vaccinations may help mitigate mortality.Abstract 990 Figure 1Systemic pathogen and infection related mortality. title_zh: 儿童 B-ALL 中 990 例 blinatumomab 免疫治疗后的感染并发症 - 来自印度一家大型三级癌症护理中心的真实世界分析
source_body_en: Background Blinatumomab’s mechanism of action induces T-cell activation and hypogammaglobulinemia which can predispose patients to infections. In LMICs, distinct environmental pathogen exposures, resource constraints, and baseline nutritional variations may amplify these risks. Real-world data regarding the infectious profile of blinatumomab in LMICs remains scarce. We aim to characterize the incidence, microbiological-spectrum, and clinical impact of infectious-complications during blinatumomab-therapy in a resource-constrained setting.Methods We conducted a retrospective cohort study of pediatric patients with relapsed/refractory B-ALL who received blinatumomab between May 2021 and March 2026 at TMH, Mumbai. Infectious episodes were captured from the initiation of blinatumomab until 60 days post-therapy and graded using CTCAE v 5.0. Clinical correlations with concomitant Cytokine Release Syndrome (CRS), Post therapy IgG Levels, and survival outcomes were analyzed.Results There were 105 patients eligible for analysis, of which 55 (52.4%) developed a febrile episode within 60 days of initiating treatment. Almost all of these (54/55) had infections and presented with systemic features in 46 (85%), and local manifestations in 8 (15%). In the latter group, half (4/8) were due to Central-line site related infection. Amongst 42 episodes of systemic infections, the most common sites were respiratory tract (n = 6,38.1%) and the bloodstream(n = 15,35.7%).There was one case of colitis-associated viraemia, one with acute suppurative otitis media (2.4%),while the primary anatomic site remained unspecified in the remaining 10 cases (23.8%). Viral etiologies were highly predominant in this subset, accounting for 50% (n = 21) of the episodes, with Measles being the most frequently isolated pathogen ( figure 1). All deaths were driven by viral pathogens, with vaccine-preventable diseases like Measles being the primary cause of death in 80% of cases (n = 4/5),due to Measles Encephalitis, and one death being due to Parainfluenzae-induced pneumonia.Conclusions Infections are common in pediatric B-ALL patients treated with blinatumomab and may occur in more than half the patients. Systemic viral pathogens predominate over bacterial in frequency and are almost exclusively responsible for mortality. Clinical severity of concomitant CRS (≥ Grade 2) and lower IgG levels correlate with infectious vulnerability. All mortality observed was in vaccine-preventable diseases. While falling community vaccination rates may be responsible for localized outbreaks, targeted interventions including influenza vaccinations may help mitigate mortality.Abstract 990 Figure 1Systemic pathogen and infection related mortality. abstract_zh: 背景 博纳吐单抗的作用机制会诱导 T 细胞活化和低丙种球蛋白血症,从而使患者易于感染。在中低收入国家,不同的环境病原体暴露、资源限制和基线营养变化可能会放大这些风险。有关 blinatumomab 在中低收入国家中感染情况的真实数据仍然很少。我们的目标是在资源有限的环境中描述 发病率、微生物谱和 blinatumomab 治疗期间感染并发症的临床影响。方法我们对 2021 年 5 月至 2026 年 3 月在孟买 TMH 接受 blinatumomab 的复发/难治性 B-ALL 儿科患者进行了一项回顾性 队列研究 研究。记录从开始使用 blinatumomab 到治疗后 60 天的感染发作情况,并使用 CTCAE v 5.0 进行分级。分析了伴随细胞因子释放综合征(CRS)、治疗后 IgG 水平和生存结果的临床相关性。结果 有 105 名患者符合分析条件,其中 55 名(52.4%)在开始 治疗 后 60 天内出现发热发作。几乎所有这些患者 (54/55) 均出现感染,并有 46 例 (85%) 出现全身症状,8 例 (15%) 出现局部症状。在后一组中,一半(4/8)是由于中心线部位相关感染。42例全身感染中,最常见的部位为呼吸道(n = 6,38.1%)和血流(n = 15,35.7%)。其中1例为结肠炎相关病毒血症,1例为急性化脓性中耳炎(2.4%),其余10例(23.8%)原发部位未明确。病毒病因在该亚群中占主导地位,占事件的 50% (n = 21),其中 麻疹 是最常见的分离病原体(图 1)。所有死亡均由病毒病原体驱动,疫苗 可预防疾病如 麻疹 是 80% 病例 (n = 4/5) 死亡的主要原因,原因是 麻疹 脑炎,其中 1 例死亡是副流感引起的肺炎。结论 感染在接受博纳吐单抗治疗的儿童 B-ALL 患者中很常见,并且可能发生在超过一半的病人。系统性病毒病原体的频率高于细菌病原体,并且几乎完全是 死亡率 的原因。伴随的 CRS 的临床严重程度(≥ 2 级)和较低的 IgG 水平与感染易感性相关。观察到的所有 死亡率 都是 疫苗 可预防的疾病。虽然社区 疫苗接种 率下降可能是造成局部 死亡率 的原因,但包括流感 死亡率 在内的有针对性的干预措施可能有助于缓解 死亡率。摘要 990 图 1 系统性病原体和感染相关的 死亡率。CRS与感染的关联摘要990 图2CRS严重程度与60天感染的关联发病率

title: Ultrasensitive detection of neuronal DNA using genome-wide non-CG methylation patterns
abstract: Summary Methylation-based liquid biopsies can identify the tissue origins of circulating cell-free DNA (cfDNA). A major constraint on the sensitivity of these assays is the limited number of cell-type-specific CpG markers. Here we exploit the high abundance of non-CpG (CpH) methylation in neurons to enable ultrasensitive detection of neuronal DNA. We show that neurons carry 100-fold higher CpH methylation than other tissues, in which apparent CpH methylation largely reflects experimental artifacts. Using a computational criterion to identify cfDNA molecules carrying clusters of methylated CpA sites, we detect neuronal DNA at proportions as low as 20 parts per million. Analysis of 231 samples from 163 individuals revealed minimal neuronal cfDNA in the plasma of healthy subjects; elevated levels in patients with measles or acute neurological conditions; strikingly high levels in brain-dead donors, indicating extensive ongoing neuronal death; and the highest levels in the cerebrospinal fluid of patients in a neurological intensive care unit. These findings establish genome-wide, fragment-level analysis of non-CpG methylation as an ultrasensitive approach for blood-based monitoring of brain injury and disease.

title: Neurological Complications of Mumps
abstract: Abstract Mumps is a vaccinepreventable viral illness that primarily affects the parotid glands but can also lead to neurological complications. During a community mumps outbreak in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India, between February and April 2025, we encountered several pediatric patients with significant central nervous system (CNS) involvement. We describe two children who presented with acute cerebellitis, meningoencephalitis with hydrocephalus, and aseptic meningitis in the setting of recent mumps infection. Detailed clinical features and shortterm outcomes are presented. All children improved with appropriate antimicrobial and antiviral therapy, immunomodulation in selected cases, and neurosurgical intervention when indicated. Our series demonstrates that severe mumpsrelated CNS disease continues to occur in partially immunized pediatric populations and can be associated with substantial morbidity. These observations highlight the importance of maintaining high measles–mumps–rubella (MMR) vaccine coverage, ensuring early recognition and comprehensive management of neurological complications, and strengthening surveillance for mumps outbreaks in India.
journal: Annals of Indian Academy of Neurology

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to address the risk and impact of neurological complications associated with mumps, a vaccine-preventable viral illness that primarily affects the parotid glands but can also lead to severe central nervous system involvement.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted during a community mumps outbreak in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India, between February and April 2025, focusing on pediatric patients who exhibited significant central nervous system involvement following mumps infection.
analysis_en.methods: The study described clinical features and short-term outcomes of two children who presented with acute cerebellitis, meningoencephalitis with hydrocephalus, and aseptic meningitis in the context of recent mumps infection.
analysis_en.main_results: The study reported that all children improved with appropriate antimicrobial and antiviral therapy, immunomodulation in selected cases, and neurosurgical intervention when indicated.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted their findings as demonstrating that severe mumps-related CNS disease continues to occur in partially immunized pediatric populations and can be associated with substantial morbidity.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings emphasize the need for maintaining high measles–mumps–rubella (MMR) vaccine coverage, ensuring early recognition and comprehensive management of neurological complications, and strengthening surveillance for mumps outbreaks in India.

source_body_en: Abstract Mumps is a vaccinepreventable viral illness that primarily affects the parotid glands but can also lead to neurological complications. During a community mumps outbreak in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India, between February and April 2025, we encountered several pediatric patients with significant central nervous system (CNS) involvement. We describe two children who presented with acute cerebellitis, meningoencephalitis with hydrocephalus, and aseptic meningitis in the setting of recent mumps infection. Detailed clinical features and shortterm outcomes are presented. All children improved with appropriate antimicrobial and antiviral therapy, immunomodulation in selected cases, and neurosurgical intervention when indicated. Our series demonstrates that severe mumpsrelated CNS disease continues to occur in partially immunized pediatric populations and can be associated with substantial morbidity. These observations highlight the importance of maintaining high measles–mumps–rubella (MMR) vaccine coverage, ensuring early recognition and comprehensive management of neurological complications, and strengthening surveillance for mumps outbreaks in India.

title: Opportunities, Challenges and Proposed Solutions in Responding to Vaccine Preventable Disease Outbreaks in Humanitarian Settings
abstract: Humanitarian crises increasingly disrupt immunization systems, accelerating transmission of vaccine-preventable diseases (VPDs). Despite a robust global response architecture, reactive vaccination campaigns in humanitarian settings remain poorly documented, frequently delayed, and operationally constrained. We conducted a structured search of published and grey literature to identify and describe reactive vaccination campaigns for five VPDs, including measles, poliomyelitis, diphtheria, meningococcal meningitis, and yellow fever, across humanitarian settings between 2015 and 2024, drawing on 316 published and grey literature sources including WHO Disease Outbreak News, GOARN, and ReliefWeb. Given substantial gaps in publicly available reporting, findings are presented as a perspective to document implementation gaps and draw practical lessons rather than as a systematic review. Of 132 identified outbreaks, reactive vaccination campaigns were documented in 83 (63%). Where reported, the median response lag was 96 days (range: 14–533). Coverage data were available for 26 outbreaks (20%), ranging from 3.7% to 109%. Implementation barriers include political and security constraints, governance and coordination failures, community hesitancy and mistrust, and operational and technical breakdowns. Documented innovations included real-time digital monitoring, diplomatically negotiated access, community-led delivery, and adaptive multi-agency coordination. Despite existing global vaccination mechanisms, critical gaps in documentation, timeliness, and coverage persist. Closing these gaps requires standardized minimum reporting, pre-established coordination frameworks with defined decision authority, embedded community engagement, and context-specific operational guidance tailored to distinct humanitarian contexts. Systematizing and funding field-proven solutions is essential to protect the most vulnerable populations and strengthen global health security.
journal: Journal of Epidemiology and Global Health

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本次审查重点关注人道主义环境中应对 暴发 和 疫苗 可预防疾病 (VPD) 的挑战和机遇,特别强调 麻疹病毒。核心问题是如何改进这些背景下反应性 疫苗接种 活动的记录、及时性和覆盖范围。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述基于对已发表文献和灰色文献(包括世界卫生组织疾病 暴发 新闻、GOARN 和 ReliefWeb)的结构化搜索,旨在识别和描述 2015 年至 2024 年间跨人道主义环境中五个 VPD(包括 麻疹)的反应性 疫苗接种 活动。总共分析了 316 个来源,但由于公开报告中的空白,该综述并未作为系统综述呈现。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在人道主义环境中,麻疹 和其他 VPD 的反应性 疫苗接种 活动经常被延迟且操作受到限制。中位反应滞后为 96 天(范围:14-533),覆盖率数据仅适用于 20% 的 暴发,范围为 3.7% 至 109%。这些发现凸显了改进文档和运营策略的必要性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 公开的报告存在巨大差距,这限制了得出全面结论的能力。该综述以视角而非系统综述的形式呈现研究结果,表明证据基础不足以进行正式的荟萃分析。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 为了弥补这些差距,审查建议需要标准化的最低限度报告、具有明确决策权的预先建立的协调框架、嵌入式社区参与以及针对不同人道主义背景的具体情况行动指南。系统化并资助经过实地验证的解决方案对于保护弱势群体和加强全球卫生安全至关重要。

Despite existing global vaccination mechanisms, critical gaps in documentation, timeliness, and coverage persist. Closing these gaps requires standardized minimum reporting, pre-established coordination frameworks with defined decision authority, embedded community engagement, and context-specific operational guidance tailored to distinct humanitarian contexts. Systematizing and funding field-proven solutions is essential to protect the most vulnerable populations and strengthen global health security.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本次审查重点关注人道主义环境中应对 暴发 和 疫苗 可预防疾病 (VPD) 的挑战和机遇,特别强调 麻疹病毒。核心问题是如何改进这些背景下反应性 疫苗接种 活动的记录、及时性和覆盖范围。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述基于对已发表文献和灰色文献(包括世界卫生组织疾病 暴发 新闻、GOARN 和 ReliefWeb)的结构化搜索,旨在识别和描述 2015 年至 2024 年间跨人道主义环境中五个 VPD(包括 麻疹)的反应性 疫苗接种 活动。总共分析了 316 个来源,但由于公开报告中的空白,该综述并未作为系统综述呈现。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在人道主义环境中,麻疹 和其他 VPD 的反应性 疫苗接种 活动经常被延迟且操作受到限制。中位反应滞后为 96 天(范围:14-533),覆盖率数据仅适用于 20% 的 暴发,范围为 3.7% 至 109%。这些发现凸显了改进文档和运营策略的必要性。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 公开的报告存在巨大差距,这限制了得出全面结论的能力。该综述以视角而非系统综述的形式呈现研究结果,表明证据基础不足以进行正式的荟萃分析。
