title: Contact coverage, content of care and inequality in antenatal care and routine immunisation in rural Uttar Pradesh, India: a repeated cross-sectional analysis of household surveys and direct observations of community health sessions.
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Community-based primary care aims to reduce geographic and opportunity-cost barriers in rural settings, yet population trends in coverage, content and education-related inequality are poorly described. In rural Uttar Pradesh (UP), monthly community health sessions (Village Health and Nutrition Days (VHNDs)) provide integrated antenatal care (ANC) and routine immunisation (RI). We describe long-term trends in coverage, content and education-related inequality, with direct observation of session readiness. METHODS: We analysed repeated cross-sectional rural UP household survey data from National Family Health Survey (NFHS)-3 (births 2001-2006), NFHS-4 (2011-2016) and NFHS-5 (2018-2020). Outcomes included any and community-level ANC/RI, content-qualified ANC (Antenatal Care Quality (ANCq) ≥8), full RI among children aged 12-23 months and ultrasound use and caesarean birth as facility-dependent comparators. Education-related inequality was quantified using the Slope Index of Inequality and Concentration Index (CIX). Direct observations of 61 133 VHND sessions (2022-2023) described input readiness and observed ANC component delivery. RESULTS: Between 2001 and 2019, any ANC increased from 51.3% to 94.8% and content-qualified ANC from 3.3% to 53.3%. Any RI remained high throughout; full RI increased from 20.8% (2004) to 71.2% (2019). Gains were largest among women with no formal education. Relative inequality narrowed for every indicator and fell close to zero for services deliverable at community level (CIX 0.502 to 0.059 for ANCq, 0.269 to 0.018 for full RI), while remaining substantial for caesarean birth (0.394 to 0.257). Sessions showed high blood pressure and haemoglobin testing capacity and strong availability for key antigens, with lower but improving urine testing and measles-rubella vaccine supply. CONCLUSIONS: Content-qualified ANC and full immunisation improved markedly, with the largest gains among the least educated women and relative inequality narrowed for every indicator except caesarean birth. Where community-deliverable services have converged across education groups, the remaining gap lies in facility-dependent care. Further gains likely depend on referral, transport and surgical capacity rather than extending first-contact outreach.

title_zh: 印度北方邦农村地区的接触覆盖率、护理内容以及产前护理和常规免疫方面的不平等:对家庭调查和社区卫生会议直接观察的重复横断面分析。
source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Community-based primary care aims to reduce geographic and opportunity-cost barriers in rural settings, yet population trends in coverage, content and education-related inequality are poorly described. In rural Uttar Pradesh (UP), monthly community health sessions (Village Health and Nutrition Days (VHNDs)) provide integrated antenatal care (ANC) and routine immunisation (RI). We describe long-term trends in coverage, content and education-related inequality, with direct observation of session readiness. METHODS: We analysed repeated cross-sectional rural UP household survey data from National Family Health Survey (NFHS)-3 (births 2001-2006), NFHS-4 (2011-2016) and NFHS-5 (2018-2020). Outcomes included any and community-level ANC/RI, content-qualified ANC (Antenatal Care Quality (ANCq) ≥8), full RI among children aged 12-23 months and ultrasound use and caesarean birth as facility-dependent comparators. Education-related inequality was quantified using the Slope Index of Inequality and Concentration Index (CIX). Direct observations of 61 133 VHND sessions (2022-2023) described input readiness and observed ANC component delivery. RESULTS: Between 2001 and 2019, any ANC increased from 51.3% to 94.8% and content-qualified ANC from 3.3% to 53.3%. Any RI remained high throughout; full RI increased from 20.8% (2004) to 71.2% (2019). Gains were largest among women with no formal education. Relative inequality narrowed for every indicator and fell close to zero for services deliverable at community level (CIX 0.502 to 0.059 for ANCq, 0.269 to 0.018 for full RI), while remaining substantial for caesarean birth (0.394 to 0.257). Sessions showed high blood pressure and haemoglobin testing capacity and strong availability for key antigens, with lower but improving urine testing and measles-rubella vaccine supply. CONCLUSIONS: Content-qualified ANC and full immunisation improved markedly, with the largest gains among the least educated women and relative inequality narrowed for every indicator except caesarean birth. Where community-deliverable services have converged across education groups, the remaining gap lies in facility-dependent care. Further gains likely depend on referral, transport and surgical capacity rather than extending first-contact outreach.
abstract_zh: 简介:以社区为基础的初级保健旨在减少农村地区的地理和机会成本障碍,但对覆盖范围、内容和教育相关不平等方面的人口趋势描述甚少。在北方邦 (UP) 农村地区,每月举行的社区健康会议(村庄健康和营养日 (VHND))提供综合产前护理 (ANC) 和常规免疫 (RI)。我们通过直接观察会议准备情况来描述覆盖范围、内容和教育相关不平等的长期趋势。方法:我们分析了来自全国家庭健康调查 (NFHS)-3(2001-2006 年出生)、NFHS-4(2011-2016 年)和 NFHS-5(2018-2020 年)的重复横断面农村 UP 家庭调查数据。结果包括任何社区层面的 ANC/RI、内容合格的 ANC(产前护理质量 (ANCq) ≥8)、12-23 个月儿童的全面 RI 以及超声使用和剖腹产作为设施依赖的比较。使用不平等斜率指数和集中指数(CIX)对与教育相关的不平等进行量化。对 61 133 个 VHND 会议(2022-2023 年)的直接观察描述了输入准备情况和观察到的 ANC 组件交付。结果:2001 年至 2019 年间,任何 ANC 从 51.3% 增加到 94.8%,内容合格的 ANC 从 3.3% 增加到 53.3%。任何 RI 自始至终都保持在高位;完整 RI 从 20.8% (2004 年) 增加到 71.2% (2019 年)。未受过正规教育的女性获得的收益最大。每项指标的相对不平等程度均有所缩小,社区层面可提供的服务的相对不平等程度接近于零(ANCq 的 CIX 为 0.502 至 0.059,完全 RI 的相对不平等为 0.269 至 0.018),而剖腹产的相对不平等程度仍然很高(0.394 至 0.257)。会议显示了高血压和血红蛋白检测能力以及关键抗原的强大可用性,尿液检测和 Z​​XQTERMZQXZ-风疹 疫苗 供应量较低但有所改善。结论:内容合格的 ANC 和全面免疫接种率显着改善,其中受教育程度最低的女性获益最大,除剖腹产外,各项指标的相对不平等程度均有所缩小。在社区提供的服务已经跨教育群体趋同的情况下,剩下的差距在于依赖设施的护理。进一步的收益可能取决于转诊、交通和手术能力,而不是扩大首次接触范围。

title: Viral Immunomodulation as a Potential Driver of Trained Immunity: Emerging Mechanisms of Innate Immune Memory and Antiviral Protection
abstract: The discovery of trained immunity has challenged the longstanding view that immunological memory is restricted to the adaptive immune system. Trained immunity refers to the capacity of innate immune cells to undergo long-term functional reprogramming following exposure to microbial, endogenous, or environmental stimuli, resulting in enhanced responses to subsequent challenges. Trained immunity is mediated by epigenetic and metabolic remodeling, including changes in chromatin accessibility, histone modifications, and cellular metabolism. Recent studies further demonstrate that these memory-like properties can also be established in hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs), providing a basis for their long-term persistence. While Bacillus Calmette–Guérin (BCG) and β-glucan are the best-characterized inducers of trained immunity, increasing evidence indicates that viral infections and viral vaccines can also induce durable innate immune reprogramming. Epidemiological studies have demonstrated heterologous protective effects associated with vaccinia, measles, and oral polio vaccines, while cytomegalovirus infection and severe SARS-CoV-2 infection have been linked to long-lasting alterations in innate immune function. Notably, many of these viruses possess potent immune evasion mechanisms that suppress interferon signaling, modulate NF-κB activation, disrupt antigen presentation, and alter myeloid cell function. We propose that viral immune evasion and immunomodulatory strategies may promote trained immunity by triggering compensatory metabolic, epigenetic, and transcriptional reprogramming that persists after resolution of infection. This review summarizes the historical development and molecular basis of trained immunity and examines emerging evidence linking viral infections and viral vaccines to innate immune memory. We further discuss the potential roles of virus-induced autophagy and long non-coding RNAs as mechanistic bridges connecting viral infection, immune reprogramming, and trained immunity. Understanding how viral infections shape innate immune memory may provide new opportunities for antiviral therapies, vaccine design, and broad-spectrum immune protection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the potential role of viral immunomodulation in driving trained immunity, challenging the traditional view that immunological memory is exclusive to the adaptive immune system. The background highlights the need to understand how viral infections and vaccines might influence innate immune memory.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a review of existing literature on viral immunomodulation and its connection to trained immunity, focusing on measles virus and related entities. It examines the molecular mechanisms and epidemiological evidence linking viral infections to innate immune memory.
analysis.methods: The methods involve a comprehensive analysis of scientific literature, including epidemiological studies and molecular mechanisms, to evaluate how viral infections and vaccines induce durable innate immune reprogramming. The review also discusses potential mechanistic bridges such as virus-induced autophagy and long non-coding RNAs.
analysis.main_results: Epidemiological studies have demonstrated heterologous protective effects associated with measles, measles virus genotype B3, and measles virus genotype D8, while viral infections have been linked to long-lasting alterations in innate immune function.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that viral immune evasion and immunomodulatory strategies may promote trained immunity by triggering compensatory metabolic, epigenetic, and transcriptional reprogramming that persists after resolution of infection. This is a novel perspective that expands the understanding of innate immune memory beyond traditional inducers like BCG and β-glucan.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform new opportunities for antiviral therapies, vaccine design, and broad-spectrum immune protection, particularly in the context of measles virus and its related genotypes.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a review of existing literature and does not include new experimental data, which may limit the strength of the conclusions. However, the evidence is derived from multiple sources and is considered moderate in strength.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the emerging concept of viral immunomodulation as a driver of trained immunity, challenging the traditional view that immunological memory is exclusive to the adaptive immune system. It highlights the potential roles of measles virus and related genotypes in inducing durable innate immune reprogramming through mechanisms such as immune evasion and metabolic changes. The study suggests that viral infections and vaccines may influence innate immune memory, offering new insights into antiviral therapies and vaccine design. While the findings are based on existing literature and are considered moderate in strength, they provide a foundation for further research into the interplay between viral infections and innate immune memory.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探索病毒免疫调节在驱动训练有素的免疫力方面的潜在作用,挑战免疫记忆是适应性免疫系统独有的传统观点。背景强调需要了解病毒感染和 疫苗 如何影响先天免疫记忆。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究回顾了有关病毒免疫调节及其与训练免疫的联系的现有文献,重点关注 麻疹病毒 和相关实体。它研究了将病毒感染与先天免疫记忆联系起来的分子机制和流行病学证据。
elements_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及对科学文献的全面分析,包括流行病学研究和分子机制,以评估病毒感染和 疫苗 如何诱导持久的先天免疫重编程。该综述还讨论了潜在的机制桥,例如病毒诱导的自噬和长非编码 RNA。
elements_zh.main_results: 流行病学研究已证明与 麻疹、麻疹病毒 基因型 B3 和 麻疹病毒 基因型 D8 相关的异源保护作用,而病毒感染与先天免疫功能的长期改变有关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,病毒免疫逃避和免疫调节策略可能通过触发感染消退后持续存在的补偿性代谢、表观遗传和转录重编程来促进训练有素的免疫力。这是一个新颖的视角,扩展了对先天免疫记忆的理解,超越了卡介苗和β-葡聚糖等传统诱导剂。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为 抗病毒药物 疗法、疫苗 设计和广谱免疫保护提供新的机会,特别是在 麻疹病毒 及其相关基因型的背景下。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于对现有文献的回顾,不包括新的实验数据,这可能会限制结论的强度。然而,证据来自多个来源,被认为强度中等。

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study is a review of existing literature on viral immunomodulation and its connection to trained immunity, focusing on measles virus and related entities. analysis_en.methods: The methods involve a comprehensive analysis of scientific literature, including epidemiological studies and molecular mechanisms, to evaluate how viral infections and vaccines induce durable innate immune reprogramming. analysis_en.main_results: Epidemiological studies have demonstrated heterologous protective effects associated with measles, measles virus genotype B3, and measles virus genotype D8, while viral infections have been linked to long-lasting alterations in innate immune function.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that viral immune evasion and immunomodulatory strategies may promote trained immunity by triggering compensatory metabolic, epigenetic, and transcriptional reprogramming that persists after resolution of infection. title_zh: 病毒免疫调节作为训练免疫的潜在驱动力:先天免疫记忆和 抗病毒药物 保护的新兴机制
source_body_en: The discovery of trained immunity has challenged the longstanding view that immunological memory is restricted to the adaptive immune system. Trained immunity refers to the capacity of innate immune cells to undergo long-term functional reprogramming following exposure to microbial, endogenous, or environmental stimuli, resulting in enhanced responses to subsequent challenges. Trained immunity is mediated by epigenetic and metabolic remodeling, including changes in chromatin accessibility, histone modifications, and cellular metabolism. Recent studies further demonstrate that these memory-like properties can also be established in hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs), providing a basis for their long-term persistence. While Bacillus Calmette–Guérin (BCG) and β-glucan are the best-characterized inducers of trained immunity, increasing evidence indicates that viral infections and viral vaccines can also induce durable innate immune reprogramming. Epidemiological studies have demonstrated heterologous protective effects associated with vaccinia, measles, and oral polio vaccines, while cytomegalovirus infection and severe SARS-CoV-2 infection have been linked to long-lasting alterations in innate immune function. Notably, many of these viruses possess potent immune evasion mechanisms that suppress interferon signaling, modulate NF-κB activation, disrupt antigen presentation, and alter myeloid cell function. We propose that viral immune evasion and immunomodulatory strategies may promote trained immunity by triggering compensatory metabolic, epigenetic, and transcriptional reprogramming that persists after resolution of infection. This review summarizes the historical development and molecular basis of trained immunity and examines emerging evidence linking viral infections and viral vaccines to innate immune memory. We further discuss the potential roles of virus-induced autophagy and long non-coding RNAs as mechanistic bridges connecting viral infection, immune reprogramming, and trained immunity. Understanding how viral infections shape innate immune memory may provide new opportunities for antiviral therapies, vaccine design, and broad-spectrum immune protection.
abstract_zh: 训练有素的免疫力的发现挑战了长期以来的观点,即免疫记忆仅限于适应性免疫系统。经过训练的免疫是指先天免疫细胞在暴露于微生物、内源性或环境刺激后进行长期功能重编程的能力,从而增强对后续挑战的反应。训练有素的免疫是通过表观遗传和代谢重塑介导的,包括染色质可及性、组蛋白修饰和细胞代谢的变化。最近的研究进一步表明,这些类似记忆的特性也可以在造血干细胞和祖细胞(HSPC)中建立,为其长期持续存在提供基础。虽然卡介苗 (BCG) 和 β-葡聚糖是训练有素的免疫的最佳特征诱导剂,但越来越多的证据表明,病毒感染和病毒 疫苗 也可以诱导持久的先天免疫重编程。流行病学研究已证明与痘苗、麻疹 和口服脊髓灰质炎 疫苗 相关的异源保护作用,而巨细胞病毒感染和严重 SARS-CoV-2 感染与先天免疫功能的长期改变有关。值得注意的是,其中许多病毒具有有效的免疫逃避机制,可以抑制干扰素信号传导、调节 NF-κB 激活、破坏抗原呈递并改变骨髓细胞功能。我们认为,病毒免疫逃避和免疫调节策略可以通过触发感染消退后持续存在的补偿性代谢、表观遗传和转录重编程来促进训练有素的免疫力。这篇综述总结了训练免疫的历史发展和分子基础,并研究了将病毒感染和病毒 疫苗 与先天免疫记忆联系起来的新证据。我们进一步讨论了病毒诱导的自噬和长链非编码 RNA 作为连接病毒感染、免疫重编程和训练免疫的机制桥梁的潜在作用。了解病毒感染如何塑造先天免疫记忆可能为 抗病毒药物 疗法、疫苗 设计和广谱免疫保护提供新的机会。

title: Multi-Pathogen Wastewater-Based Epidemiology Before, During, and After the Milano-Cortina 2026 Winter Olympic and Paralympic Games: Monitoring of the Alpine Tourist Sewersheds of the Province of Trento
abstract: Given worldwide advances in wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE), its implementation is also emerging in international sporting events. The WBE application to a major international sporting event held under winter and cold-climate conditions remains unexplored. The Milano-Cortina 2026 Winter Olympic and Paralympic Games, hosted in the Alpine region, provided a unique opportunity to explore the potential of wastewater surveillance during the winter period, when seasonal diseases also drive pathogen circulation. This paper presents the results of the WBE surveillance conducted in the Province of Trento, over six months (November 2025-April 2026) and covering the periods before, during, and after the Winter Olympic and Paralympic Games. A total of 96 wastewater samples were collected from six wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) serving the Fiemme and Fassa valleys, with a total census population of about 29,000 but reaching 143,000 population equivalents during tourist periods. The WBE monitoring involved quantitative analyses of SARS-CoV-2, influenza A/B, RSV A/B, and Norovirus GI/GII, as well as screening for measles. Norovirus GI/GII and RSV A/B circulated as the number of event-related visitors increased, whereas SARS-CoV-2 and influenza viruses remained at background or seasonal levels. Clinical surveillance data in the Province of Trento effectively complemented this multi-pathogen WBE. In conclusion, this experience provided non-invasive, community-wide information and demonstrated the operational feasibility and usefulness of WBE as a multi-pathogen sentinel tool for situational awareness to complement public health surveillance.

title_zh: 基于多病原体废水的 流行病学 2026 年米兰-科尔蒂纳冬奥会和残奥会之前、期间和之后:特伦托省高山旅游污水处理厂的监测
source_body_en: Given worldwide advances in wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE), its implementation is also emerging in international sporting events. The WBE application to a major international sporting event held under winter and cold-climate conditions remains unexplored. The Milano-Cortina 2026 Winter Olympic and Paralympic Games, hosted in the Alpine region, provided a unique opportunity to explore the potential of wastewater surveillance during the winter period, when seasonal diseases also drive pathogen circulation. This paper presents the results of the WBE surveillance conducted in the Province of Trento, over six months (November 2025-April 2026) and covering the periods before, during, and after the Winter Olympic and Paralympic Games. A total of 96 wastewater samples were collected from six wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) serving the Fiemme and Fassa valleys, with a total census population of about 29,000 but reaching 143,000 population equivalents during tourist periods. The WBE monitoring involved quantitative analyses of SARS-CoV-2, influenza A/B, RSV A/B, and Norovirus GI/GII, as well as screening for measles. Norovirus GI/GII and RSV A/B circulated as the number of event-related visitors increased, whereas SARS-CoV-2 and influenza viruses remained at background or seasonal levels. Clinical surveillance data in the Province of Trento effectively complemented this multi-pathogen WBE. In conclusion, this experience provided non-invasive, community-wide information and demonstrated the operational feasibility and usefulness of WBE as a multi-pathogen sentinel tool for situational awareness to complement public health surveillance.
abstract_zh: 鉴于基于废水的 流行病学 (WBE) 在全球范围内的进步,其实施也在国际体育赛事中兴起。WBE 在冬季和寒冷气候条件下举办的大型国际体育赛事中的应用仍有待探索。在阿尔卑斯地区举办的 2026 年米兰-科尔蒂纳冬季奥运会和残奥会为探索冬季废水 监测 的潜力提供了独特的机会,因为冬季季节性疾病也会促进病原体循环。本文介绍了在特伦托省进行的 WBE 监测 为期六个月(2025 年 11 月至 2026 年 4 月)的结果,涵盖冬奥会和残奥会之前、期间和之后的时期。从为 Fiemme 和 Fassa 山谷提供服务的 6 个 治疗 污水处理厂 (WWTP) 中总共收集了 96 个废水样本,普查总人口约为 29,000 人,但在旅游期间达到 143,000 人口当量。WBE 监测涉及 SARS-CoV-2、流感 A/B、RSV A/B 和诺如病毒 GI/GII 的定量分析,以及 麻疹 的筛查。诺如病毒 GI/GII 和 RSV A/B 随着与活动相关的参观者数量的增加而传播,而 SARS-CoV-2 和流感病毒仍处于背景或季节性水平。特伦托省的临床 监测 数据有效补充了这种多病原体 WBE。总之,这一经验提供了非侵入性的全社区信息,并证明了 WBE 作为态势感知的多病原体哨兵工具的操作可行性和有用性,以补充公共卫生 监测。

title: MULTILEVEL BRAIN DAMAGE IN PAEDIATRIC VIRAL PANENCEPHALITIS: COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS OF STRUCTURAL, METABOLIC AND CONDUCTIVE MR CHANGES
abstract: Panencephalitis following measles and other viral infections is again becoming a clinical problem in children, with a wide spectrum of presentations from mild to rapidly progressive forms [1]. Brain damage in these patients may involve the cortex, deep white matter and brainstem [2], and the structural, metabolic and conducting components of the lesion do not necessarily develop in parallel. Understanding how these components combine is important for choosing the scope of MR examination and for prognosis [3].

The findings suggest that understanding these complex changes can improve clinical management. title: Prediction of Grape Disease using Deep Learning based on MobileNetV2 and Explainable AI with Grad-CAM for Disease Management
abstract: The grapes production can be affected by diseases that cause changes to the look and state of the leaves and may reduce the quality of the crop if the disease are not detected in time. Even though visual diagnosis is of some help, it depends on the operator's experience and can become difficult when different diseases show similar symptoms. The study presents an image-based approach for predicting and Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) for providing a visual explanation. The System can detect four kinds of disease: Black Measles, Black Rot, Healthy, and Isariopsis Leaf Spot. The model produces a distribution of class probabilities and Grad-CAM is used to highlight the parts of the image that are related to the predicted class. A general module based on knowledge then provides information regarding the symptoms, advice on how to manage the disease, and preventive measures for the disease which has been predicted. Having been tested on 903 images, the system achieved 886 correct predictions and 17 incorrect ones, giving an accuracy of 98.12%, a weighted precision of 98.13%,a weighted recall of 98.12%, and a weighted F1-score of 98.12%. The errors that were seen were mostly between Black Measles and Black Rot. The study therefore incorporates prediction, visual explanation, and disease-management information into one workflow, while at the same time recognizing the need for further validation with a wider variety of field images..
authors: Rani Bharat Bansode and Ms. Snigdha Shukla
journal: International Journal of Advanced Research in Science Communication and Technology

abstract_zh: 葡萄的生产可能会受到疾病的影响,这些疾病会导致叶子的外观和状态发生变化,如果不及时发现疾病,可能会降低作物的质量。尽管视觉诊断有一定帮助,但它取决于操作者的经验,并且当不同的疾病表现出相似的症状时可能会变得困难。该研究提出了一种基于图像的预测方法和梯度加权类激活映射(Grad-CAM)以提供视觉解释。该系统可以检测四种病害:黑病麻疹、黑腐病、健康病和白斑病。该模型生成类别概率的分布,并使用 Grad-CAM 突出显示图像中与预测类别相关的部分。然后,基于知识的通用模块提供有关症状的信息、如何管理疾病的建议以及针对已预测疾病的预防措施。经过903张图像的测试,系统实现了886个正确预测和17个错误预测,准确率为98.12%,加权精度为98.13%,加权召回率为98.12%,加权F1分数为98.12%。发现的错误主要发生在 Black 麻疹 和 Black Rot 之间。因此,该研究将预测、视觉解释和疾病管理信息纳入一个工作流程,同时认识到需要使用更广泛的现场图像进行进一步验证。

title: Childhood vaccination at a crossroads: rebuilding confidence, overcoming inequities, and translating scientific advances into global health gains.
abstract: The resurgence of measles is a warning that decades of progress in childhood immunisation cannot be taken for granted. A Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2023 analysis covering 204 countries and territories estimates 15.6 million measles cases and 118,000 deaths among children younger than five years in 2023. Following a decline of approximately 79% in estimated cases between 1990 and 2019, cases increased by 40% between 2019 and 2023. First-dose measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) coverage was estimated at 81.0% and second-dose (MCV2) coverage at 71.4% in 2023 [1] These are modelled estimates with substantial uncertainty, not surveillance case counts.
journal: International journal of infectious diseases : IJID : official publication of the International Society for Infectious Diseases

title: Non-Medical Exemptions, Socioeconomic Factors, and MMR Coverage, 2015-2023
abstract: Non-medical exemptions (NMEs) permit children to forgo required school vaccinations for religious or philosophical reasons and have been consistently linked to reduced measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccination coverage in prior studies. National coverage fell to 93.1% during the 2022-23 school year, below the 95% threshold needed for herd immunity, and existing literature has not examined multi-year state-level trends in NMEs alongside socio-economic indicators. To address this gap, this study evaluated associations between state-level NME rate, socio-economic factors, and MMR coverage across the United States from 2015 to 2023. It was hypothesized that higher NME rate would be associated with lower MMR coverage and that socio-economic indicators would be significantly associated with NME rate. Pearson correlation and simple linear regression were selected to quantify linear relationships between variables using publicly available state-level data from the CDC SchoolVaxView database and the U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey. Higher NME rate was significantly associated with lower MMR coverage (r = -0.44, p < 0.001), explaining approximately 19.5% of coverage variance. Contrary to expectations and some prior literature suggesting socio-economic barriers reduce vaccination coverage, median household income was positively associated with NME rate (r = 0.13, p = 0.013), while educational attainment (p = 0.578) and health insurance coverage (p = 0.158) were not significant predictors. Average NME rate varied nearly 15-fold across states, from 7.7% in Idaho to 0.5% in the District of Columbia. These findings indicate that exemption behaviors, rather than income-related access barriers, more directly correspond to reduced MMR coverage, particularly in higher-income communities. Interpretation is limited by the cross-sectional, correlational design, potential state-level confounders, and incomplete NME reporting in several states. Future multivariable analyses incorporating policy differences and changes in exemption laws over time could clarify these mechanisms and help guide targeted vaccination outreach and policy interventions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 非医疗豁免 (NME) 允许儿童出于宗教或哲学原因放弃所需的学校 麻疹,并且在之前的研究中一直与 麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹 (MMR) 麻疹 覆盖率的降低有关。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2022-23 学年,全国覆盖率下降至 93.1%,低于群体免疫所需的 95% 阈值,并且现有文献没有研究 NME 的多年州级趋势以及社会经济指标。
elements_zh.methods: 选择皮尔逊相关性和简单线性回归来量化变量之间的线性关系,使用来自 CDC SchoolVaxView 数据库和美国人口普查局美国社区调查的公开州级数据。
elements_zh.main_results: 较高的 NME 率与较低的 MMR 覆盖率显着相关(r = -0.44,p < 0.001),解释了大约 19.5% 的覆盖率方差。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 与预期和一些先前文献表明社会经济障碍减少 疫苗接种 覆盖率的预期相反,家庭收入中位数与 NME 率呈正相关(r = 0.13,p = 0.013),而教育程度(p = 0.578)和健康保险覆盖率(p = 0.158)并不是显着的预测因素。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,豁免行为,而不是与收入相关的准入障碍,更直接地对应于 MMR 覆盖率的降低,特别是在高收入社区。

title_zh: 非医疗豁免、社会经济因素和 MMR 覆盖范围,2015-2023 年
source_body_en: Non-medical exemptions (NMEs) permit children to forgo required school vaccinations for religious or philosophical reasons and have been consistently linked to reduced measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccination coverage in prior studies. National coverage fell to 93.1% during the 2022-23 school year, below the 95% threshold needed for herd immunity, and existing literature has not examined multi-year state-level trends in NMEs alongside socio-economic indicators. To address this gap, this study evaluated associations between state-level NME rate, socio-economic factors, and MMR coverage across the United States from 2015 to 2023. It was hypothesized that higher NME rate would be associated with lower MMR coverage and that socio-economic indicators would be significantly associated with NME rate. Pearson correlation and simple linear regression were selected to quantify linear relationships between variables using publicly available state-level data from the CDC SchoolVaxView database and the U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey. Higher NME rate was significantly associated with lower MMR coverage (r = -0.44, p < 0.001), explaining approximately 19.5% of coverage variance. Contrary to expectations and some prior literature suggesting socio-economic barriers reduce vaccination coverage, median household income was positively associated with NME rate (r = 0.13, p = 0.013), while educational attainment (p = 0.578) and health insurance coverage (p = 0.158) were not significant predictors. Average NME rate varied nearly 15-fold across states, from 7.7% in Idaho to 0.5% in the District of Columbia. These findings indicate that exemption behaviors, rather than income-related access barriers, more directly correspond to reduced MMR coverage, particularly in higher-income communities. Interpretation is limited by the cross-sectional, correlational design, potential state-level confounders, and incomplete NME reporting in several states. Future multivariable analyses incorporating policy differences and changes in exemption laws over time could clarify these mechanisms and help guide targeted vaccination outreach and policy interventions.
abstract_zh: 非医疗豁免 (NME) 允许儿童出于宗教或哲学原因放弃所需的学校 麻疹,并且在之前的研究中一直与 麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹 (MMR) 麻疹 覆盖率的降低有关。2022-23 学年,全国覆盖率下降至 93.1%,低于群体免疫所需的 95% 阈值,并且现有文献没有研究 NME 的多年州级趋势以及社会经济指标。为了解决这一差距,本研究评估了 2015 年至 2023 年美国州级 NME 率、社会经济因素和 MMR 覆盖率之间的关联。假设较高的 NME 率与较低的 MMR 覆盖率相关,而社会经济指标将与 NME 率显着相关。选择皮尔逊相关性和简单线性回归来量化变量之间的线性关系,使用来自 CDC SchoolVaxView 数据库和美国人口普查局美国社区调查的公开州级数据。较高的 NME 率与较低的 MMR 覆盖率显着相关(r = -0.44,p < 0.001),解释了大约 19.5% 的覆盖率方差。与预期和一些先前文献表明社会经济障碍减少 疫苗接种 覆盖率的预期相反,家庭收入中位数与 NME 率呈正相关(r = 0.13,p = 0.013),而教育程度(p = 0.578)和健康保险覆盖率(p = 0.158)并不是显着的预测因素。各州的平均 NME 率相差近 15 倍,从爱达荷州的 7.7% 到哥伦比亚特区的 0.5%。这些发现表明,豁免行为,而不是与收入相关的准入障碍,更直接地对应于 MMR 覆盖率的降低,特别是在高收入社区。解释受到横截面相关设计、潜在的州级混杂因素以及多个州不完整的 NME 报告的限制。未来的多变量分析结合政策差异和豁免法随时间的变化可以澄清这些机制,并有助于指导有针对性的 疫苗接种 外展和政策干预。

title: Edukasi Tenaga Medis dan Non-Medis dalam Mencegah Wabah Campak di Rumah Sakit Islam Sultan Agung
abstract: Campak disebabkan oleh infeksi virus Measles yang sangat menular dan dapat menimbulkan wabah. Campak menyebabkan gejala seperti demam, ruam, konjungtivitis, batuk pilek, dan bercak Koplik. Campak dapat sembuh sendiri/self limited disease, namun bisa menimbulkan komplikasi berat. Indonesia merupakan negara berkembang dengan angka kasus campak 10 tertinggi di dunia pada tahun 2026. Rumah sakit merupakan salah satu tempat yang berpotensi terjadi penularan dan wabah campak. Tujuan kegiatan pengabdian masyarakat ini adalah meningkatkan pengetahuan petugas medis dan non-medis sebagai garda terdepan pelayanan kesehatan di rumah sakit terkait kasus campak. Metode yang digunakan meliputi pengisian data responden dan soal pre-test, penyuluhan kesehatan, praktik kebersihan tangan sebagai kewaspadaan standar, diskusi dan tanya jawab, serta diakhiri dengan pengisian post-test oleh responden. Hasil kegiatan menunjukkan adanya peningkatan pengetahuan responden dilihat dari peningkatan rerata nilai post-test yaitu 97,36 dibandingkan rerata nilai pre-test yaitu 87,42. Hasil uji Wilcoxon menunjukkan nilai p=0,000 (p<0,05), terdapat peningkatan pengetahuan yang signifikan setelah edukasi kesehatan. Kegiatan ini menunjukkan bahwa kegiatan edukasi dapat meningkatkan pengetahuan petugas medis dan non-medis terkait pencegahan penyakit campak di rumah sakit.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the need for increasing awareness among medical and non-medical staff in a hospital setting to prevent measles outbreaks, given the highly contagious nature of the measles virus and its potential to cause wabah in healthcare facilities.

analysis.main_results: The results showed a significant improvement in knowledge among the participants, with post-education scores increasing from 87.42 to 97.36, as confirmed by a Wilcoxon test with a p-value of 0.000.

analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the small sample size and the lack of a control group, which may affect the generalizability of the results. The evidence strength is moderate.

Indonesia merupakan negara berkembang dengan angka kasus campak 10 tertinggi di dunia pada tahun 2026. Rumah sakit merupakan salah satu tempat yang berpotensi terjadi penularan dan wabah campak. Tujuan kegiatan pengabdian masyarakat ini adalah meningkatkan pengetahuan petugas medis dan non-medis sebagai garda terdepan pelayanan kesehatan di rumah sakit terkait kasus campak. Metode yang digunakan meliputi pengisian data responden dan soal pre-test, penyuluhan kesehatan, praktik kebersihan tangan sebagai kewaspadaan standar, diskusi dan tanya jawab, serta diakhiri dengan pengisian post-test oleh responden. Hasil kegiatan menunjukkan adanya peningkatan pengetahuan responden dilihat dari peningkatan rerata nilai post-test yaitu 97,36 dibandingkan rerata nilai pre-test yaitu 87,42. Hasil uji Wilcoxon menunjukkan nilai p=0,000 (p<0,05), terdapat peningkatan pengetahuan yang signifikan setelah edukasi kesehatan. Kegiatan ini menunjukkan bahwa kegiatan edukasi dapat meningkatkan pengetahuan petugas medis dan non-medis terkait pencegahan penyakit campak di rumah sakit.

title: Household Headship and Inequality of Opportunity in Child Nutrition and Immunisation Coverage in India
abstract: This study explores the inequality of opportunity in nutrition and immunisation coverage among Indian children, with particular attention to household headship, using the most recent National Family Health Survey (NFHS)-5 (2019–2021) on children’s health indicators. Children’s health status was assessed through indicators such as stunting (height-for-age Z -score < −2), wasting (weight-for-height Z -score < −2), being underweight (weight-for-age Z -score < −2) and immunisation coverage (Bacillus Calmette–Guérin (BCG) vaccine, diphtheria, tetanus and pertussis (DTaP) vaccine, polio vaccine and measles vaccine). Children aged 0–59 months were included for nutritional assessment, and those aged 12–23 months were considered for immunisation. The study constructs the Human Opportunity Index to measure the inequality of opportunity considering household headship and employs Shapley decomposition to analyse the contributing factors to such an inequality. The findings reveal that households headed by women are more vulnerable to stunting in children compared to those led by men. Furthermore, children from the higher-income groups were observed to have a much lower chance of experiencing stunting, wasting or being underweight. Wealth status is also positively and significantly associated with immunisation coverage. The study shows that household wealth significantly shapes children’s health opportunities, reducing malnutrition and enhancing immunisation outcomes. Sanitation contributes to disparities in nutritional outcomes, particularly among underweight (18.8%) and wasted (17%) children. Religious beliefs were found to influence wasting in children (16.9%) and immunisation choices of households (21.8%), while female-headed households show modest effects (4% on wasting, 1.3% on stunting).

It uses data from the National Family Health Survey (NFHS)-5 (2019–2021) to assess health indicators such as stunting, wasting, and underweight in children aged 0–59 months, and immunisation coverage in those aged 12–23 months. The research highlights that female-headed households are more vulnerable to stunting, while higher-income groups show lower rates of malnutrition. The findings suggest that household wealth significantly influences children’s health opportunities, reducing malnutrition and improving immunisation outcomes. However, the evidence does not report limitations or evidence strength specific to the measles virus.

abstract_zh: 本研究利用关于儿童健康指标的最新国家家庭健康调查 (NFHS)-5(2019-2021),探讨了印度儿童在营养和免疫覆盖率方面的机会不平等,特别关注户主。通过发育迟缓(年龄别身高 Z 值 < -2)、消瘦(身高别体重 Z 值 < -2)、体重不足(年龄别体重 Z 值 < -2)和免疫覆盖率(卡介苗 (BCG) 疫苗、白喉、破伤风和百日咳 (DTaP))等指标评估儿童的健康状况疫苗、脊髓灰质炎 疫苗 和 麻疹 疫苗)。0-59 个月的儿童被纳入营养评估,12-23 个月的儿童被考虑进行免疫接种。该研究构建了人类机会指数来衡量考虑家庭户主地位的机会不平等,并采用沙普利分解来分析造成这种不平等的因素。调查结果显示,与男性为户主的家庭相比,女性户主的家庭更容易出现儿童发育迟缓的情况。此外,据观察,来自高收入群体的儿童发育迟缓、消瘦或体重不足的可能性要低得多。财富状况也与免疫覆盖率呈显着正相关。研究表明,家庭财富可以显着影响儿童的健康机会,减少营养不良并提高免疫效果。卫生条件造成营养结果的差异,尤其是体重不足(18.8%)和消瘦(17%)儿童。研究发现,宗教信仰会影响儿童消瘦(16.9%)和家庭的免疫选择(21.8%),而女户主家庭的影响不大(4%对消瘦,1.3%对发育迟缓)。

title: Maternal Knowledge of Childhood Immunization and Its Association with Full Immunization Status Among Mothers of Children Aged 12–23 Months in a Riverine Community of Rivers State, Nigeria
abstract: Maternal knowledge is a modifiable determinant of childhood vaccination, yet little is known about its level among mothers in the riverine communities of the Niger Delta. This study assessed the level of maternal knowledge about immunisation and its association with full immunisation status among children aged 12–23 months in Asari-Toru Local Government Area (ASALGA), Rivers State, Nigeria. A community-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 374 mothers or primary caregivers selected through multistage sampling. Knowledge was measured with a 13-item interviewer-administered scale (score 0–13) and categorised as good (9–13), fair (5–8) or poor (0–4). Associations with full immunisation were examined using chi-square tests and binary logistic regression. Only 25.7% of mothers had good knowledge, 48.7% had fair knowledge and 25.7% had poor knowledge. Although 93.0% had heard of childhood immunisation, only 49.2% knew the age for measles vaccination. Full immunisation coverage was 52.1%, 30.8% and 16.7% among children of mothers with good, fair and poor knowledge, respectively (p < 0.001). Good knowledge remained independently associated with full immunisation (AOR = 5.22; 95% CI: 2.46–11.08). Awareness of immunisation is high, but specific, actionable knowledge of the schedule is deficient and is associated with incomplete vaccination. Schedule-specific, culturally adapted health education delivered beyond clinic walls should be prioritised in riverine communities.
journal: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF MEDICAL EVALUATION AND PHYSICAL REPORT

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the level of maternal knowledge about childhood immunisation and its association with full immunisation status among children aged 12–23 months in a riverine community in Rivers State, Nigeria. A cross-sectional survey of 374 mothers revealed that only 25.7% had good knowledge, 48.7% had fair knowledge, and 25.7% had poor knowledge. Full immunisation coverage was significantly higher among children of mothers with good knowledge (52.1%) compared to those with fair (30.8%) or poor (16.7%) knowledge. The study found that good maternal knowledge was independently associated with full immunisation (AOR = 5.22; 95% CI: 2.46–11.08). These findings underscore the importance of targeted health education to improve vaccination rates in such communities. The study's cross-sectional design limits its ability to establish causality, and the evidence is considered moderate in strength due to the reliance on self-reported data.

title: In vivo models for rustrela virus (RusV) infection in potential reservoir and spill-over hosts
abstract: ABSTRACT Rustrela virus (RusV; species Rubivirus strelense ) is a recently discovered relative of the human rubella virus ( Rubivirus rubellae ) and causes fatal non-suppurative meningoencephalomyelitis in a broad range of mammalian domestic, wild and zoo animals, in Europe and the USA, including ‘staggering disease’ in domestic cats. Based on its reportedly broad host range, a zoonotic potential of RusV cannot be excluded. Apparently healthy yellow-necked field mice ( Apodemus flavicollis ) and wood mice ( Apodemus sylvaticus ) were identified as potential reservoir hosts. In this study, we experimentally inoculated wood mice and Lewis rats with brain homogenates of RusV-infected animals. Intracranial as well as combined intranasal/peroral inoculation resulted in apparently persistent RusV infection in both rodent species, while combined intramuscular/subcutaneous injection failed to establish detectable infection. Viral loads were highest in the central nervous system, but viral RNA was prominently found also in mucosal organs of wood mice. Viral RNA was frequently detected in oral swabs from infected wood mice, but only sparsely from rats. Neither wood mice nor rats presented neurological signs during twelve weeks after infection. However, RusV-infected rats showed significantly reduced body weight. A lymphohistiocytic meningoencephalomyelitis was observed in infected rats, whereas infected wood mice infrequently developed minimal lesions in the brain. Our study provides the first infection model for RusV and indicates that natural infection may occur via mucosal routes. Shedding of viral RNA suggests wood mice to serve as natural reservoir hosts. title: Vaccine-Induced Antibody and T Cell Immunity to Measles and Varicella in Children With ALL.
abstract: Abstract Children with acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) are treated with multiagent chemotherapy that causes profound changes to the immune system. There are limited data on how disease and therapy impact antigen-specific immune memory, leading to inconsistent guidelines on best practices for revaccination of this population. Here, to inform vaccine guidance, we investigated whether immunity derived from routine childhood measles and varicella zoster virus (VZV) vaccines is maintained during and after therapy for childhood ALL. We report that antibodies against measles and VZV were significantly reduced in children with ALL (n=45) compared to healthy controls (n=13), particularly in older children in whom a longer time had passed since their most recent vaccine dose. However, the avidity of the measles and VZV-specific antibodies was indistinguishable between groups. Despite changes to the composition of the T cell compartment, both overall and antigen-specific T cell function were preserved in children with ALL. These data provide compelling evidence for revaccination of children following ALL treatment. Intact T cell responses suggest that post-treatment revaccination would be effective.

title_zh: 疫苗 诱导 ALL 儿童对 麻疹 和水痘的抗体和 T 细胞免疫。
source_body_en: Abstract Children with acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) are treated with multiagent chemotherapy that causes profound changes to the immune system. There are limited data on how disease and therapy impact antigen-specific immune memory, leading to inconsistent guidelines on best practices for revaccination of this population. Here, to inform vaccine guidance, we investigated whether immunity derived from routine childhood measles and varicella zoster virus (VZV) vaccines is maintained during and after therapy for childhood ALL. We report that antibodies against measles and VZV were significantly reduced in children with ALL (n=45) compared to healthy controls (n=13), particularly in older children in whom a longer time had passed since their most recent vaccine dose. However, the avidity of the measles and VZV-specific antibodies was indistinguishable between groups. Despite changes to the composition of the T cell compartment, both overall and antigen-specific T cell function were preserved in children with ALL. These data provide compelling evidence for revaccination of children following ALL treatment. Intact T cell responses suggest that post-treatment revaccination would be effective.
abstract_zh: 摘要 患有急性淋巴细胞白血病(ALL)的儿童接受多药化疗,这会导致免疫系统发生深刻的变化。关于疾病和治疗如何影响抗原特异性免疫记忆的数据有限,导致该人群重新接种疫苗的最佳实践指南不一致。在此,为了向 疫苗 提供指导,我们研究了在儿童 ALL 治疗期间和治疗后是否维持了源自常规儿童 麻疹 和水痘带状疱疹病毒 (VZV) 疫苗 的免疫力。我们报告说,与健康对照 (n = 13) 相比,ALL 儿童 (n = 45) 的 麻疹 和 VZV 抗体显着减少,特别是在距离最近一次 疫苗 剂量已经过去较长时间的年龄较大的儿童中。然而,麻疹 和 VZV 特异性抗体的亲合力在各组之间无法区分。尽管 T 细胞区室的组成发生了变化,但 ALL 儿童的整体 T 细胞功能和抗原特异性 T 细胞功能均得以保留。这些数据为接受 ALL 治疗 治疗的儿童重新接种疫苗提供了令人信服的证据。完整的 T 细胞反应表明 治疗 后的重新接种是有效的。

Angulo-Zamudio2CDE, Jorge Velazquez-Roman2CDE, Hector Flores-Villaseñor2CDE, Erika Acosta-Smith2CDE, Julio Enrique Castañeda-Delgado4ACDE, Juan Carlos Borrego-Moreno 1ABCDEFG DOI: 10.12659/AJCR.954333 Am J Case Rep In Press; DOI: 10.12659/AJCR.954333 Available online: 2026-11-04, In Press, Corrected Proof Publication in the "In-Press" formula aims at speeding up the public availability of the pending manuscript while waiting for the final publication. The availability of the article in the Medline, PubMed and PMC databases as well as Web of Science will be obtained after the final publication according to the journal schedule Abstract BACKGROUND The global resurgence of measles has been accompanied by reports of breakthrough infection in previously immunized individuals, including healthcare personnel. Breakthrough measles can present with attenuated or atypical findings, but the clinical spectrum in fully vaccinated adults remains incompletely characterized. During outbreaks, documenting laboratory-confirmed cases in vaccinated healthcare workers is clinically relevant. CASE REPORT We describe a 30-year-old male pediatrician with a fully vaccinated history for measles, including 2 childhood doses and a measles-rubella booster in 2017, who developed measles after occupational exposure to an unvaccinated 6-year-old patient. Six days after exposure, he developed fever and a cephalocaudal maculopapular rash, followed by progressive systemic and respiratory symptoms, including cough, pharyngitis, and mild pain on breathing. On day 9, a room-air oxygen saturation of 92% prompted brief supplemental oxygen and short inpatient observation. Chest auscultation was normal, and thus chest radiography was not performed. Oxygenation improved rapidly with supportive care. Measles virus RNA was detected by real-time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction in a pharyngeal swab. He received supportive care, was hospitalized for 2 days, and recovered fully after 2 weeks of follow-up, with no documented complications or secondary cases among monitored contacts. CONCLUSIONS This case provides a descriptive, laboratory-confirmed example of breakthrough measles in a fully vaccinated healthcare worker during an active outbreak. Although these observations are consistent with partial or waning immunity, the exact mechanism of vaccine failure could not be established because pre-exposure measles serology and viral genotyping were not performed. Serological surveillance or targeted booster strategies for healthcare personnel should be regarded as context-dependent considerations requiring support from broader epidemiologic and serologic evidence. title_original: A 30-Year-Old Male Pediatrician With Documented Complete Vaccination History and Laboratory-Confirmed Breakthrough Measles With Respiratory Involvement During a Measles Outbreak in Mexico

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to document a case of breakthrough measles in a fully vaccinated healthcare worker during an outbreak, highlighting the clinical relevance of such cases in vaccinated individuals. The global resurgence of measles has been accompanied by reports of breakthrough infections in previously immunized individuals, including healthcare personnel.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This is a case report describing a 30-year-old male pediatrician with a documented complete vaccination history who developed measles after occupational exposure to an unvaccinated 6-year-old patient during a measles outbreak in Mexico. The study was conducted during an active outbreak in Mexico.
analysis.methods: The case was evaluated through clinical observation and laboratory testing, including real-time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction to detect measles virus RNA in a pharyngeal swab. The patient received supportive care and was hospitalized for 2 days, with follow-up for 2 weeks.
analysis.main_results: Measles virus RNA was detected by real-time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction in a pharyngeal swab. The patient developed fever and a cephalocaudal maculopapular rash, followed by progressive systemic and respiratory symptoms, including cough, pharyngitis, and mild pain on breathing. Oxygenation improved rapidly with supportive care, and no complications or secondary cases were documented.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret this case as a descriptive, laboratory-confirmed example of breakthrough measles in a fully vaccinated healthcare worker during an active outbreak. The case contributes to understanding the clinical spectrum of measles in vaccinated adults.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This case highlights the importance of documenting laboratory-confirmed breakthrough measles in vaccinated healthcare workers during outbreaks, which can inform surveillance and the potential need for targeted booster strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited by the absence of pre-exposure measles serology and viral genotyping, which prevents establishing the exact mechanism of vaccine failure. The study provides a descriptive example but lacks broader epidemiologic data, resulting in moderate confidence.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old male pediatrician with a complete vaccination history who developed breakthrough measles during an outbreak in Mexico. The patient presented with fever, rash, and respiratory symptoms, and measles virus RNA was detected in a pharyngeal swab. He received supportive care, was hospitalized for 2 days, and fully recovered within 2 weeks without complications or secondary cases. The case underscores the clinical relevance of breakthrough infections in vaccinated healthcare workers and suggests the need for further epidemiologic and serologic studies. However, the absence of pre-exposure serology and viral genotyping limits the understanding of the exact mechanism of vaccine failure, resulting in moderate confidence in the findings.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一篇 病例报告 文章,描述了一名 30 岁的男性儿科医生,他有完整的 疫苗接种 病史记录,他在墨西哥 麻疹 暴发 期间与一名未接种疫苗的 6 岁患者职业接触后患上了 麻疹。该研究是在墨西哥活跃的 暴发 期间进行的。
elements_zh.methods: 该病例通过临床观察和实验室检测进行评估,包括实时逆转录聚合酶链反应检测咽拭子中的 麻疹病毒 RNA。患者接受支持治疗并住院 2 天,随访 2 周。
elements_zh.main_results: 通过咽拭子中的实时逆转录聚合酶链反应检测 麻疹病毒 RNA。患者出现发烧和头尾斑丘疹,随后出现进行性全身和呼吸道症状,包括咳嗽、咽炎和轻微呼吸疼痛。通过支持治疗,氧合作用迅速改善,并且没有并发症或继发病例记录。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此病例解释为一个描述性的、经实验室证实的、在活跃的 麻疹 期间在完全接种疫苗的医护人员中实现 麻疹 突破的示例。该病例有助于了解 麻疹 在接种疫苗的成人中的临床谱。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该案例强调了在 暴发 期间记录已接种疫苗的医护人员中实验室确认的突破性 麻疹 的重要性,这可以为 监测 以及有针对性的加强策略的潜在需求提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于缺乏暴露前 麻疹 血清学 和病毒基因分型,证据受到限制,这阻碍了建立 疫苗 失败的确切机制。该研究提供了一个描述性例子,但缺乏更广泛的流行病学数据,因此可信度中等。

full_text: Pennsylvania is experiencing its worst measles outbreak in more than three decades, with more than 1,400 confirmed cases and six measles-associated deaths so far in 2026, according to statistics compiled by the state. Each new case brings a new warning of a measles exposure in that community. Exposures have occurred at hospitals and doctors’ offices, grocery stores and restaurants, and K-12 schools and universities. Exposure alerts come with the same instructions: Check your MMR vaccine status, and watch for symptoms for the next three weeks. People are told that two doses of the measles, mumps and rubella vaccine are 97% effective at preventing measles. The underlying message is that if you’re vaccinated, you’re protected. The MMR vaccine is highly effective at preventing disease, but it isn’t a guarantee. People may hear that 97% figure and wonder about the other 3%. Parents ask me: Should I be worried? How do I know if my kid has measles? Do I need an MMR booster? Most recently, my teenage daughter texted me to ask about her MMR vaccine status. She was worried about what would happen if she were exposed. These are questions I can answer as both a mother and an epidemiologist in northwestern Pennsylvania. I became both at once. My daughter was born at the start of my doctoral program, and I read epidemiology textbooks aloud to her while studying for my comprehensive exams. I defended my dissertation on my son’s due date. I’m a better mother because I’m an epidemiologist, and a better epidemiologist because I’m a mom. Are these measles exposure alerts cause for alarm? The advice in each public measles exposure alert matches the guidance doctors follow when a patient may have been exposed. Everyone is asked to watch for symptoms, whether or not they’re vaccinated. The number of unvaccinated people across Pennsylvania is growing. As a result, many communities, including Allegheny County, no longer have herd immunity. Four of the over 1,400 confirmed measles cases in Pennsylvania were people who had been vaccinated. These cases are known as breakthrough infections. The term “herd immunity” wasn’t coined until 1918. That year, a veterinarian wrote about an outbreak of “contagious abortion” in sheep and cattle, a literal herd. Today, herd immunity means that the risk of disease for susceptible people, those without immunity, drops when they are surrounded by people who are immune. In other words, if the people around you are immune, you’re unlikely to get sick even if you’re susceptible. For measles, that protection depends on about 95% of people being immune. In a school or community where fewer than 95% of people are vaccinated, measles can spread more easily. In Allegheny County, 93.8% of children are fully vaccinated against measles. Some neighborhoods are above 97% uptake, while others are below the necessary 95% needed for herd immunity. What happens after an exposure? Measles exposures are announced publicly by the Department of Health and local healthcare providers. During a measles outbreak, public health departments may get in touch with close contacts to alert them to an exposure. Public exposure alerts, like the one made in October after there was a measles exposure at a Target near Pittsburgh, are also used. Public alerts are for settings where exposed people can’t be identified and contacted individually. Measles is so contagious that a single case can infect up to 18 susceptible people. Measles spreads through the air and through respiratory droplets, like those released when someone sneezes. The virus can also survive outside the body, lingering in the air and on surfaces. Imagine I have measles and walk into my local grocery store. I’m contagious from about four days before the rash appears until four days after. Every time I breathe out, I release virus particles into the air, and those particles can stay infectious for up to two hours. If I sneeze in the produce section, the virus can survive on surfaces for up to two hours. However, if you’ve had measles or were vaccinated with two doses of the MMR vaccine, you are protected. Two doses provides 97% lifetime protection against measles. This means that even without herd immunity, fewer than 3% of individuals with immunity are likely to contract measles. Adults who have had measles, or who have documentation of the recommended doses of the MMR vaccine, don’t need a booster. People who were vaccinated between 1963 and 1967, or who aren’t sure which vaccine they received, should talk to their primary care provider about whether they need another dose. This is because the measles vaccine used between those years was not as effective as the MMR vaccine that is currently given. Today, children typically get their first dose of the MMR vaccine at 12 to 15 months old and a second dose at 4 to 6 years old. Because the vaccine is given in early childhood, people born in the early to mid-1960s are the most likely to have received the older vaccine. People born before 1957 are generally considered immune, because measles was so widespread then that almost everyone caught it as a child. What are the symptoms of measles? Symptoms of measles include a high fever that can reach 105 degrees Fahrenheit (40.6 degrees Celsius), a cough, a runny nose and conjunctivitis, also known as pin keye. These symptoms overlap with those of other respiratory viruses, such as flu and COVID-19. Most people with measles develop a red, blotchy rash. It starts on the face and spreads down the body, like paint poured from a bucket. People who are immunocompromised or were previously vaccinated, even with one dose of the MMR vaccine, may not develop the rash. Between 25% and 40% of immunocompromised people with measles never get the rash. A telltale sign of measles is Koplik spots, tiny white spots inside the mouth that can show up a day or two before the rash. Why does measles keep making headlines? Measles can have serious consequences. About 1 in 20 people with measles develop pneumonia, and up to 3 in 1,000 cases end in death. Children younger than 5 and adults older than 20 are most likely to experience these severe complications. Without herd immunity in many communities, measles cases, hospitalizations and deaths in Pennsylvania are likely to keep rising. The state Department of Health reports community spread of measles in 14 of Pennsylvania’s 67 counties. Each of these cases is mostly preventable with the MMR vaccine. The U.S. declared measles eliminated in 2000, meaning it was no longer spreading continuously here. This year’s outbreak shows how quickly that can change and the negative health consequences it can have in our communities. Read more of our stories about Pittsburgh and Pennsylvania.

title_original: What the measles vaccine’s ‘97% effective’ rating means for Pittsburgh parents

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the public health concern of measles outbreaks in Pennsylvania and the effectiveness of the MMR vaccine in preventing measles, particularly in light of the 97% effectiveness rating and its implications for communities with low vaccination rates.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is based on public health statistics and epidemiological observations from Pennsylvania, focusing on measles cases and vaccination rates among children and adults in Allegheny County and other affected areas.
analysis.methods: The study relies on public health records, exposure alerts, and epidemiological data to assess vaccination rates and measles transmission dynamics, without conducting new experiments or detailed statistical analyses.
analysis.main_results: Four of the over 1,400 confirmed measles cases in Pennsylvania were among vaccinated individuals, and 93.8% of children in Allegheny County are fully vaccinated against measles, with some neighborhoods below the 95% threshold needed for herd immunity.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the 97% effectiveness of the MMR vaccine as providing strong protection, but not absolute immunity, and highlight the importance of maintaining high vaccination rates to prevent outbreaks, noting that even vaccinated individuals can contract measles in rare cases.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform public health strategies for measles prevention, emphasizing the need for maintaining high vaccination coverage to achieve herd immunity and reduce the risk of outbreaks, particularly in communities with lower uptake.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is based on public health statistics and does not include detailed experimental data or randomized trials, which limits the strength of the conclusions to a moderate level.

analysis.summary_en: This article discusses the measles outbreak in Pennsylvania in 2026, highlighting the 97% effectiveness of the MMR vaccine and the importance of herd immunity. It explains that while the vaccine is highly effective, it is not foolproof, and communities with vaccination rates below 95% are at risk. The piece also notes that some vaccinated individuals can still contract measles, and that public health alerts are used to inform people of exposures. The author, an epidemiologist, shares personal and professional insights into the implications of these findings for parents and public health officials.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了宾夕法尼亚州 麻疹 暴发 的公共卫生问题,以及 MMR 疫苗 在预防 麻疹 方面的有效性,特别是考虑到 97% 的有效性评级及其对 疫苗接种 率低的社区的影响。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究基于宾夕法尼亚州的公共卫生统计数据和流行病学观察,重点关注阿勒格尼县和其他受影响地区儿童和成人的 麻疹 病例和 疫苗接种 比率。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究依靠公共卫生记录、暴露警报和流行病学数据来评估 疫苗接种 率和 麻疹 传播 动态,而无需进行新的实验或详细的统计分析。
analysis_zh.main_results: 宾夕法尼亚州 1,400 多例 麻疹 确诊病例中有 4 例是接种疫苗的个体,阿勒格尼县 93.8% 的儿童已完全接种 麻疹 疫苗,一些社区低于群体免疫所需的 95% 阈值。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将 MMR 疫苗 97% 的有效性解释为提供了强大的保护,但不是绝对的免疫力,并强调了维持高 疫苗接种 率以预防 暴发 的重要性,并指出即使接种疫苗的个体在极少数情况下也可能感染 麻疹。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为 麻疹 预防的公共卫生策略提供了信息,强调需要保持 麻疹 的高覆盖率,以实现群体免疫并降低 麻疹 的风险,特别是在吸收率较低的社区。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据基于公共卫生统计数据,不包括详细的实验数据或随机试验,这将结论的强度限制在中等水平。

Arts + Culture Economy Education Environment + Energy Ethics + Religion Health Politics + Society Science + Tech World Podcasts Local Demand for the MMR vaccine has risen in Pennsylvania as the state’s measles outbreak has grown. Joe Raedle via Getty Images News What the measles vaccine’s ‘97% effective’ rating means for Pittsburgh parents Published: November 6, 2026 8:13am EST Pennsylvania is experiencing its worst measles outbreak in more than three decades, with more than 1,400 confirmed cases and six measles-associated deaths so far in 2026, according to statistics compiled by the state. Each new case brings a new warning of a measles exposure in that community. Exposures have occurred at hospitals and doctors’ offices, grocery stores and restaurants, and K-12 schools and universities. Exposure alerts come with the same instructions: Check your MMR vaccine status, and watch for symptoms for the next three weeks. People are told that two doses of the measles, mumps and rubella vaccine are 97% effective at preventing measles. The underlying message is that if you’re vaccinated, you’re protected. The MMR vaccine is highly effective at preventing disease, but it isn’t a guarantee. People may hear that 97% figure and wonder about the other 3%. Parents ask me: Should I be worried? How do I know if my kid has measles? Do I need an MMR booster? Most recently, my teenage daughter texted me to ask about her MMR vaccine status. She was worried about what would happen if she were exposed. These are questions I can answer as both a mother and an epidemiologist in northwestern Pennsylvania. I became both at once. My daughter was born at the start of my doctoral program, and I read epidemiology textbooks aloud to her while studying for my comprehensive exams. I defended my dissertation on my son’s due date. I’m a better mother because I’m an epidemiologist, and a better epidemiologist because I’m a mom. Are these measles exposure alerts cause for alarm? The advice in each public measles exposure alert matches the guidance doctors follow when a patient may have been exposed. Everyone is asked to watch for symptoms, whether or not they’re vaccinated. The number of unvaccinated people across Pennsylvania is growing. As a result, many communities, including Allegheny County, no longer have herd immunity. Four of the over 1,400 confirmed measles cases in Pennsylvania were people who had been vaccinated. These cases are known as breakthrough infections. Pop-up clinics in Pennsylvania have offered MMR vaccines as the state’s measles outbreak grows. Sean Rayford/Stringer via Getty Images News The term “herd immunity” wasn’t coined until 1918. That year, a veterinarian wrote about an outbreak of “contagious abortion” in sheep and cattle, a literal herd. Today, herd immunity means that the risk of disease for susceptible people, those without immunity, drops when they are surrounded by people who are immune. In other words, if the people around you are immune, you’re unlikely to get sick even if you’re susceptible. For measles, that protection depends on about 95% of people being immune. In a school or community where fewer than 95% of people are vaccinated, measles can spread more easily. In Allegheny County, 93.8% of children are fully vaccinated against measles. Some neighborhoods are above 97% uptake, while others are below the necessary 95% needed for herd immunity. What happens after an exposure? Measles exposures are announced publicly by the Department of Health and local healthcare providers. During a measles outbreak, public health departments may get in touch with close contacts to alert them to an exposure. Public exposure alerts, like the one made in October after there was a measles exposure at a Target near Pittsburgh, are also used. Public alerts are for settings where exposed people can’t be identified and contacted individually. Measles is so contagious that a single case can infect up to 18 susceptible people. Measles spreads through the air and through respiratory droplets, like those released when someone sneezes. The virus can also survive outside the body, lingering in the air and on surfaces. Imagine I have measles and walk into my local grocery store. I’m contagious from about four days before the rash appears until four days after. Every time I breathe out, I release virus particles into the air, and those particles can stay infectious for up to two hours. If I sneeze in the produce section, the virus can survive on surfaces for up to two hours. However, if you’ve had measles or were vaccinated with two doses of the MMR vaccine, you are protected. Two doses provides 97% lifetime protection against measles. This means that even without herd immunity, fewer than 3% of individuals with immunity are likely to contract measles. Adults who have had measles, or who have documentation of the recommended doses of the MMR vaccine, don’t need a booster. People who were vaccinated between 1963 and 1967, or who aren’t sure which vaccine they received, should talk to their primary care provider about whether they need another dose. This is because the measles vaccine used between those years was not as effective as the MMR vaccine that is currently given. Today, children typically get their first dose of the MMR vaccine at 12 to 15 months old and a second dose at 4 to 6 years old. Because the vaccine is given in early childhood, people born in the early to mid-1960s are the most likely to have received the older vaccine. People born before 1957 are generally considered immune, because measles was so widespread then that almost everyone caught it as a child. What are the symptoms of measles? Symptoms of measles include a high fever that can reach 105 degrees Fahrenheit (40.6 degrees Celsius), a cough, a runny nose and conjunctivitis, also known as pin keye. These symptoms overlap with those of other respiratory viruses, such as flu and COVID-19. Most people with measles develop a red, blotchy rash. It starts on the face and spreads down the body, like paint poured from a bucket. People who are immunocompromised or were previously vaccinated, even with one dose of the MMR vaccine, may not develop the rash. Between 25% and 40% of immunocompromised people with measles never get the rash. A telltale sign of measles is Koplik spots, tiny white spots inside the mouth that can show up a day or two before the rash. Why does measles keep making headlines? Measles can have serious consequences. About 1 in 20 people with measles develop pneumonia, and up to 3 in 1,000 cases end in death. Children younger than 5 and adults older than 20 are most likely to experience these severe complications. Without herd immunity in many communities, measles cases, hospitalizations and deaths in Pennsylvania are likely to keep rising. The state Department of Health reports community spread of measles in 14 of Pennsylvania’s 67 counties. Each of these cases is mostly preventable with the MMR vaccine. The U.S. declared measles eliminated in 2000, meaning it was no longer spreading continuously here. This year’s outbreak shows how quickly that can change and the negative health consequences it can have in our communities. Read more of our stories about Pittsburgh and Pennsylvania. full_text: Tobacco tax reform resultsRecent tobacco tax reforms in low- and middle-income countries are demonstrating how higher excise taxes can reduce smoking while generating revenue for health and development. A new analysis of 15 countries found that all improved cigarette taxation between 2009 and 2025, with the strongest results achieved through substantial tax increases, simpler tax systems and measures to prevent tobacco products from becoming more affordable over time. The Philippines recorded real cigarette price increases of more than 600% and noted that tobacco-tax reforms helped finance the expansion of universal health coverage. Bangladesh, Brazil, India, Mexico and Pakistan also reported notable declines in tobacco use. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess the impact of tobacco tax reforms on reducing smoking rates and generating revenue for health and development in low- and middle-income countries, building on the WHO’s 3 by 35 Initiative.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A new analysis of 15 countries examined tobacco tax reforms between 2009 and 2025, focusing on real price increases and their effects on tobacco use, with particular emphasis on the Philippines and other nations that reported notable declines in tobacco use.
analysis.methods: The study analyzed data on cigarette taxation and price changes across 15 countries, including real price increases and the implementation of measures to prevent tobacco products from becoming more affordable over time.
analysis.main_results: Bangladesh, Brazil, India, Mexico and Pakistan reported notable declines in tobacco use, while the Philippines recorded real cigarette price increases of more than 600% and noted that tobacco-tax reforms helped finance the expansion of universal health coverage.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings support the WHO’s 3 by 35 Initiative by demonstrating that substantial tax increases, simpler tax systems and measures to prevent affordability can effectively reduce tobacco use and generate revenue for health and development.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide evidence for the effectiveness of tobacco tax reforms in reducing smoking rates and supporting health financing, which can inform public health policies and interventions in low- and middle-income countries.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on reported data and does not include detailed statistical analyses or controls, but the evidence is strong due to the consistent findings across multiple countries and the alignment with WHO initiatives.

analysis.summary_en: This analysis evaluates the impact of tobacco tax reforms in low- and middle-income countries, showing that substantial tax increases, simpler systems and affordability measures have led to declines in tobacco use. The Philippines recorded over 600% real price increases, supporting the WHO’s 3 by 35 Initiative. These findings highlight the potential of tax reforms to reduce smoking and generate health funding, which can guide public health policies. However, the study relies on reported data without detailed statistical analysis, limiting the confidence in its conclusions. The results align with global efforts to address noncommunicable diseases through economic interventions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在以世界卫生组织的 3 by 35 倡议为基础,评估烟草税改革对降低吸烟率以及为低收入和中等收入国家的健康和发展创造收入的影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项针对 15 个国家的新分析审查了 2009 年至 2025 年间的烟草税改革,重点关注实际价格上涨及其对烟草使用的影响,特别重点关注菲律宾和其他报告烟草使用量显着下降的国家。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究分析了 15 个国家的卷烟税收和价格变化数据,包括实际价格上涨以及防止烟草产品随着时间的推移变得更便宜的措施的实施。
elements_zh.main_results: 孟加拉国、巴西、印度、墨西哥和巴基斯坦报告烟草使用量显着下降,而菲律宾的卷烟实际价格上涨了 600% 以上,并指出烟草税改革有助于为扩大全民健康覆盖提供资金。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果支持世界卫生组织的“3 by 35”倡议,证明大幅增税、简化税收制度和防止负担能力的措施可以有效减少烟草使用并为健康和发展创造收入。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为烟草税改革在降低吸烟率和支持卫生筹资方面的有效性提供了证据,这可以为低收入和中等收入国家的公共卫生政策和干预措施提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对报告数据的依赖而受到限制,并且不包括详细的统计分析或控制,但由于多个国家的一致研究结果以及与世卫组织举措的一致性,证据是强有力的。

full_text: Abstract Skin diseases such as Monkeypox, Chickenpox, Measles, and other dermatological conditions pose significant challenges for accurate and timely diagnosis due to their visual similarity and variability in lesion presentation. Computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems leveraging AI have emerged as powerful tools to assist in the early and accurate detection of diseases like Monkeypox, enabling improved healthcare outcomes. This study introduces a novel approach for multi-class skin disease diagnosis. The methodology utilizes the Swin Transformer (ST) as a feature extractor, leveraging its ability to capture complex visual patterns in high-dimensional image data. Feature selection (FS) methods, including Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Mutual Information, Chi-square (\(\chi ^2\)), and Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE), are applied to identify the most relevant features, reducing noise and computational overhead. These optimized features are then classified using a range of machine learning classifiers, including Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), and Naive Bayes (NB). Among these, the combination of \(\chi ^2\) with RF and RFE with RF consistently achieves the highest diagnostic accuracy. The performance of this approach is rigorously evaluated using 5-fold cross-validation. The proposed method achieves 98.31% accuracy, 98.31% recall, 98.36% precision, and 98.33% F1-score using \(\chi ^2\) and RFE with Random Forest on original images. This represents a 4.44% improvement in accuracy compared to previous models. These results demonstrate that combining effective feature extraction and selection techniques with robust classifiers provides a highly accurate and efficient solution for automated skin disease diagnosis. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the challenges of accurately diagnosing Monkeypox and other visually similar skin diseases, which have been a significant public health concern due to their clinical resemblance and variability in lesion presentation.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study employed a deep learning framework for automated skin disease diagnosis, focusing on Monkeypox using a dataset of skin images. The methodology involved feature extraction and selection techniques to enhance diagnostic accuracy.
analysis.methods: The study used the Swin Transformer for feature extraction and applied feature selection methods such as Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Mutual Information, Chi-square (\(\chi^2\)), and Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) to identify relevant features. These optimized features were then classified using machine learning classifiers including Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), and Naive Bayes (NB).
analysis.main_results: The proposed method achieved 98.31% accuracy, 98.31% recall, 98.36% precision, and 98.33% F1-score using \(\chi^2\) and RFE with Random Forest on original images. This represents a 4.44% improvement in accuracy compared to previous models.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these results as demonstrating the effectiveness of combining feature extraction and selection techniques with robust classifiers for automated Monkeypox diagnosis. The novelty lies in the integration of Swin Transformer with feature selection methods for improved diagnostic performance.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide a highly accurate and efficient solution for automated Monkeypox diagnosis, which can aid in early detection and improve healthcare outcomes, particularly in resource-limited settings where rapid and reliable diagnostic tools are essential.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's results are based on a dataset of skin images, and while the methodology is robust, the generalizability to real-world clinical settings may be limited. The evidence is moderate due to the reliance on a single dataset and the absence of direct clinical validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a novel deep learning framework for Monkeypox diagnosis using the Swin Transformer and feature selection techniques. The research addresses the challenges of accurately distinguishing Monkeypox from other skin diseases due to their visual similarity. The methodology combines feature extraction with various selection methods to enhance diagnostic accuracy. The results show a significant improvement in accuracy, recall, precision, and F1-score compared to previous models. The authors interpret these findings as demonstrating the effectiveness of integrating advanced feature extraction with robust classifiers for automated diagnosis. The study's implications suggest that this approach can improve early detection and healthcare outcomes. However, the evidence is moderate due to the reliance on a single dataset and the lack of direct clinical validation, which may limit generalizability.
